Agate_011.desc: The Treasure Land used to be beautiful. Where have all those monsters that have taken it over come from? Take my tuck nets to capture all of them.
Agate_011.name: Athenian Quartermaster

Agate_012.desc: The Treasure Land used to be beautiful. Where have all those monsters that have taken it over come from? Take my tuck nets to capture all of them.
Agate_012.name: Spartan Quartermaster

Alcatraz_Island_001.desc: I can't remember how long I've been here, nor can I remember the number of criminals this place has housed over the years. You can leave this place early if you can pass my 3 tests, or else, you will serve your full term here with me. Note: You have to wait 5 minutes before you can have another try.
Alcatraz_Island_001.name: Correction Officer

Arena_001.desc: I offer the best quality peanuts, fried sunflower seeds, beer, benches and more.
Arena_001.name: Arena Vendor

Arena_002.desc: Take care anytime you venture outside. Do you need me to find you a doctor?
Arena_002.name: Arena Doorkeeper

Arena_003.desc: If you are not strong enough, you will very likely return from the outside on a stretcher.
Arena_003.name: Arena Gatekeeper

Arena_005.desc: I am the best physician in Greece. What can I do for you?
Arena_005.name: Physician

Arena_006.desc: I offer the best airdrop for the community.
Arena_006.name: Airdrop Merchant

Argolis_All_001.desc: I must defend my country, why not come with me? Argolis and Argo Town are Sparta's allies.
Argolis_All_001.name: Menesthes

Argolis_All_002.desc: Oh, the oracle says: You are a good man.
Argolis_All_002.name: Eurumedon

Argolis_All_003.desc: ...It's hasn't been safe recently. I hope the war will be over soon. I hope the Gods are watching over us on Olympus.
Argolis_All_003.name: Menelaos

Argolis_All_004.desc: What a fine day! Why not go hunting outdoors?
Argolis_All_004.name: Aeoliah

Argolis_All_005.desc: I am the descendant of the Tantalus family... That is to say I have noble blood.
Argolis_All_005.name: Agamemnon

Argolis_All_006.desc: I am a little tired, you can have a try... Maybe this job is not fit for me. Everyone says postmen are the best marathon athletes.
Argolis_All_006.name: Postman

Argolis_All_007.desc: Artemis will bless us. I will become her priest and provide offerings for her.
Argolis_All_007.name: [Props]Iphigenia

Argolis_All_008.desc: Carving a boar head or other beasts on the shield can frightens enemies. But what if the enemies are of the same kind?
Argolis_All_008.name: Tydeus

Argolis_All_009.desc: All members of the Argo Volunteer Club are great.
Argolis_All_009.name: Argo Volunteer

Argolis_All_011.desc: Jason invited me to travel at sea. Only I can talk with the deceased.
Argolis_All_011.name: Mopsus

Argolis_All_012.desc: I am Odysseus's herdsman. Did you see him? He is great, I will follow him forever.
Argolis_All_012.name: Eumaeus

Argolis_All_013.desc: Exchange Sheepskin Scroll 7 for Lost Book Chapter 7.
Argolis_All_013.name: Ancient Relics 7

Argolis_All_014.desc: I am the best physician in Greece. What can I do for you?
Argolis_All_014.name: Spartan Physician

Argolis_All_015.desc: From 7:00pm through 9:00pm on Fridays, you can claim some deadly poisons from me and then turn it over to an Assassin with the mission of taking down the hostile Consul. You can even choose to do it yourself, which is more rewarding but more risky.     Assassin's Location:                                              Megara (-83,-87)       Megara (152,-92)     Plataea(-139,60)   Consul's Location:                                                 Megara (28,-104)
Argolis_All_015.name: Spartan Apothecary

Argolis_All_016.desc: Hey brave warrior, I am the Spartan Consul. What have you got to contribute?
Argolis_All_016.name: Spartan Consul

Argolis_All_017.desc: You can submit poisons to me in an attempt to assassinate the hostile Consul.
Argolis_All_017.name: Athenian Assassin

Argolis_All_018.desc: You can submit poisons to me in an attempt to assassinate the hostile Consul.
Argolis_All_018.name: Athenian Assassin

Athens_001.desc: Improving the public order should be your top priority right now. Although Athena can protect us, she is not always free.
Athens_001.name: Meletiou

Athens_002.desc: Hey,why are you here? I am the Captain, though it's a junior military title in Athens, I love my job.
Athens_002.name: Neocles

Athens_003.desc: What can I do for you? I am patrolling. Recruits must adapte themselves to the team ASAP. Semele is the hero Cadmus's daughter, so she has the manner of the Cadmus family.
Athens_003.name: Azanes

Athens_004.desc: Do you want to taste my snacks? I am a chef. There are few people as skillful as me. I will make a lot of food for the sacrifice ceremomy every time.
Athens_004.name: Bubassus

Athens_005.desc: What can I do for you? I am very busy now. I have too many clothing orders to deal with. I hope more tailors will come to Athens.
Athens_005.name: Hybla

Athens_006.desc: The world originates from a point, can you understand?.. Before Zeus, there was Cronus. Before Cronus was Uranus, well, who was beforeUranus?
Athens_006.name: Hesper

Athens_007.desc: I will be a great man like my teacher and give a stunning lecture to all citizens in the amphitheater.
Athens_007.name: Nausipahnes

Athens_008.desc: Do you feel that art has no borders? In Greece, there are three kinds of columns: Doric,Ionic, Corinthian. I wish to be a sculptor in the future.
Athens_008.name: Polyclitus

Athens_009.desc: Athens is a free and democratic city.
Athens_009.name: Kreion

Athens_010.desc: Hi, I haven't seen you before... Do you want some wine? Wini Wine is very popular now.
Athens_010.name: Jacinta

Athens_011.desc: The Olympian Gods have blessed you... All gods are relatives of Zeus, but they don't get along very often.
Athens_011.name: [Priest]Saizeriya

Athens_012.desc: Happy Thanksgiving Day, my brave fighters! Could you bring me some turkey meat and Thanksgiving Gift Certificates? If you do, I will reward you handsomely. If you also bring me one Thanksgiving Greetings Card, you will get even more rewards. Go ahead, there are a lot of turkeys just waiting for you to chase them in the Marathon_All.
Athens_012.name: Thanksgiving Envoy

Athens_013.desc: Have you ever found treasures? If you know some clues, please tell me! I am an archaeologist. Ancient kings liked to bury  treasures in their tombs.
Athens_013.name: Adeimantus

Athens_014.desc: Er, haven't I seen you before? You are a newcomer, right?...
Athens_014.name: Ariston

Athens_015.desc: Don't touch me. Jason won't know I am here. I will go back later.
Athens_015.name: Medea

Athens_016.desc: When you decide to go to a labyrinth, you should prepare enough string so that you can use it to make a trail. Once I went on an expedition to Knossos in Crete this way. There were Minos and Minotaur living there.
Athens_016.name: Theseus

Athens_017.desc: Which god do you like? Have you seen Satyr Gens? They are all attendants of Pan.
Athens_017.name: Europa

Athens_018.desc: Doing the legwork is interesting, but I must be exhausted after running every day.Have a good rest... You, too... I will pray for Hermes's blessing to let me have a pair of wings.
Athens_018.name: Postman

Athens_019.desc: Athens is a good place. So is Sparta to the southwest of Athens. But they are engaged in war now.
Athens_019.name: Paris

Athens_020.desc: A warrior must have strong body as well as excellent wisdom, what's more, never give up!
Athens_020.name: [Sage]Gideon

Athens_021.desc: You should take enough potion to sustain your strength. I have many kinds to choose from.
Athens_021.name: [Props]Anemone

Athens_022.desc: If you meet the Siren, remember to cover you ears or else you will be enchanted.
Athens_022.name: [Jewelry]Circe

Athens_023.desc: Hello. I have various armor. They can improve your defense, don't miss out!
Athens_023.name: [Armor]Alastor

Athens_024.desc: If you've reached Level 50 and you wish to take on a wanted quest, come see me before 9:00pm. I can help you by issuing up to 5 wanted quests each day. Once the wanted quest you've taken on has been completed and turned in to the Wanted Quest Assesor, you will be rewarded. You can also help with wanted quests others have taken on, but you can only complete 5 wanted quests at most on any single day.
Athens_024.name: Wanted Quest Issuer

Athens_025.desc: After the logistics are developed, I will suggest they form a Federal Trade Bank. Thus,the Atticas Alliance in Athens will become stronger.
Athens_025.name: [Warehouse]Kyriakou

Athens_026.desc: Hi, what weapon do you need?
Athens_026.name: [Warrior]Demetrius

Athens_027.desc: Even if you are a scholar, you should carry several weapons!
Athens_027.name: [Scholar]Renee

Athens_028.desc: To forge Metal containers you must use a high temperature. You can master it after learning for a period. But processing and enchasing gems requires skills and patience. Not everyone can do it.
Athens_028.name: [Jewelry]Artisan

Athens_029.desc: Three cobblers equal a rich man. A Fable  says, the rich will get used to the cobbler's smell after staying together.
Athens_029.name: [Armor]Cobbler

Athens_030.desc: The Guild instance is currently not active.
Athens_030.name: [Guild] Instance Supervisor

Athens_031.desc: Welcome, to our Mooncake Exchange this Mid-Autumn Festival!                Hail, my friend! I come a long way from the East, and I must say I have definite interest in Greek cuisine! Do you happen to have a Greek Cuisine Recipe with you? If not, I know a few ways you could get one! 1) At 2:00AM, 6:00AM, 10:00AM, 2:00PM, 6:00PM and 10:00PM daily, the Artemis Treasure Chest Leader will appear in the wilds - defeat him to get one!  2) Exchange Delicate Mooncakes with the Lunar Priest, and you might get one too!             If you already have a Greek Cuisine Recipe, you can exchange it with me for a Delicate Mooncake quest scroll!
Athens_031.name: Oriental Cuisine Master

Athens_032.desc: Welcome to the Mid-Autumn wish-making event! I heard an Oriental Cuisine Master is in town, and he is an expert at making delicate mooncakes as offerings to Artemis, the goddess of the moon. Can you bring me back some of these delicious mooncakes? I promise rich rewards for your effort. Rewards: Character Exp, Pet Exp, Character TP, Energy Zodiac. Starts: TodayEnds: Please stay tuned for upcoming announcements on our official website.
Athens_032.name: Lunar Priest

Athens_033.desc: During 11:00am to 11:45am Wed. and Sun. 9:00pm to 9:45pm Sat,the transporter beside me can send you to the Pindus Mountain Battlefield.
Athens_033.name: Pindus Master

Athens_034.desc: Do you need my help to turn in a completed wanted quest? Once you've completed one wanted quest, I will reward you with one medal, which can be exchanged with the Wanted Warrant Issuer beside me for a variety of cool items.
Athens_034.name: Wanted Quest Assessor

Athens_035.desc: Ho ho ho, Merry Christmas! This year, we’re gonna make the BIGGEST reindeer in the name of the festive spirit – one horn at a time! At the top of every odd hour (1:00AM, 3:00AM, etc.) in Marathon, Parnitha and Megara, a horde of mischievous little reindeers will be running rampant in the city, and it will be up to YOU to capture these little devils with a pair of special gloves from me! Of course, you’ll be rewarded accordingly – capture enough of these reindeers to upgrade the Giant Reindeer by a level, and everyone gets an extra reward each time!
Athens_035.name: Santa Claus

Athens_036.desc: Hi, people like to call me Simon. I want to create a tactical training school.
Athens_036.name: [Skill]Simonides

Athens_037.desc: The logistical distribution of Atticas is in the control of the Athens Noble Council, even the king cannot be involved in it.
Athens_037.name: [Props]Vendor

Athens_038.desc: All Guild members must help build up the Guild. Do this by completing any of my quests, and we will keep your contributions in mind.
Athens_038.name: [Guild] Quest Supervisor

Athens_039.desc: Hi, please pray to Athena every week so that you will get her blessing.
Athens_039.name: [Daily Quest]Main City Issuer

Athens_040.desc: Warriors, are you ready? Fight for Athens.
Athens_040.name: [Polis Quest]Issuer

Athens_041.desc: I can send you to a remote place, but I suggest you reach a certain level before going there.
Athens_041.name: Transporter

Athens_042.desc: My reflection is more beautiful than myself. I love my reflection. My heart is broken when the water wave ripples.
Athens_042.name: Narcissus

Athens_043.desc: Hey, boy, why do you point at me? Do you want to join the council? You need more training.
Athens_043.name: Senator

Athens_044.desc: In Greece, you can choose to be a Warrior, Champion, Mage or Priest. Each of these classes have their own strong points.   If you are Level 100 or below, I am willing to shift your class to another and also shift your equipped items into items specific to the new class for free. If you are above Level 100, you should hand me 1 Class Shift Permit, otherwise I won't help you to shift your class.
Athens_044.name: Class Shifter

Athens_045.desc: Collect sunflowers, sell them and make a living... Don't disturb me...
Athens_045.name: Citizen

Athens_046.desc: I want to found a choir.
Athens_046.name: Actress

Athens_047.desc: It is said there is a three headed dog guarding the way to Hades. Its name is Cerberus.
Athens_047.name: Traveler

Athens_048.desc: I have hunted lots of lions. It's not so great! Hercules has a helmet made of lion fur.
Athens_048.name: Retired Soldier

Athens_049.desc: Hey, traveler, I am Menetheus, the Athenian Guild Registrar. As long as you have reached level 30 and possess a "Guild Stone", I will approve the founding of your guild so that numerous Greek fighters will gather around you. If a guild lord is offline for 15 consecutive days, any guild member can apply to dismiss the lord. After the application is successful, a new guild lord will be elected according to members' position and Gold contribution.
Athens_049.name: [Guild] Guild Reg

Athens_050.desc: Now I am in charge of communication between you and gods. Athena will bless all Athens warriors.
Athens_050.name: [Guild]Alter Supervisor

Athens_051.desc: As a member of the guild, you are entitled to all the benefits of membership. Come here for weekly prayer to double your EXP and talent points.
Athens_051.name: [Guild] Member Advisor

Athens_052.desc: I am Ares's daughter and I live in the Acropolis near Athens. What do you want to exchange for?
Athens_052.name: [Exchange]Alcippe

Athens_053.desc: Happy Halloween! Everybody will be able to get a beautiful Halloween suit from me on this day each year. I also have plenty of pumpkin candy to give away......Oh, where is it?......where's my pumpkin candy?......The little candies played a trick on me! They have changed into devils and flown to the main city to cause trouble. Put on your Halloween suit and catch them using the mysteriously powerful Halloween wand. Catch them and I'll reward you well.
Athens_053.name: Halloween Envoy

Athens_054.desc: To increase the efficiency of camp construction, I gather various kinds of resources from citizens on behalf of the country on a random basis. Just bring your resources to us if you need to exchange them. Satisfactory terms and conditions are guaranteed! The first phase of the Hermes Stone recycling program will conclude soon, and the second phase of the Life Essence and Crystal recycling program has officially begun. Remember, these programs don't last long, so please make a quick move if you'd like to exchange your resources!
Athens_054.name: Retrieving Officer

Athens_055.desc: War is imminent! In order to tally the number of soldiers fit for duty, the general has asked me to distribute one Nameplate to each Athenian warrior every day from Monday to Saturday. The Nameplates can be exchanged for Talent Points and Exp. Come improve your fighting abilities in defense of our beloved Athens!
Athens_055.name: Faction Crier

Athens_056.desc: Our war with the Spartans has raged for a generation – from the Pindus Mountain to the Lelantine Farm. Euboea have always been good friends with us, but now they are being attacked by our enemies. We cannot stand by idly. From  10:45pm and 11:30pm on Saturdays, you can enter the Lelantine Farm to teach those Spartans a lesson. Notes:  Claim your rewards for the fight before 11:55pm, or else you will forfeit them.
Athens_056.name: Battlefield Transporter

Athens_057.desc: You may be a stranger, but I am glad to help you nonetheless. By the way, if you see my friend, Pylades, please tell him to pay me a visit.
Athens_057.name: [Village Leader]Admes

Athens_058.desc: I am Cupid, the god of love and beauty. If you wish to marry your sweetheart then you can get engaged to them here. Then you must go to get a Whelk Necklace for me from Pan's Maze. Remember to apply to get married once you've got the necklace. I am not free every day, you know.                                              Notes: It's the man's responsibility to submit the applications to get engaged, married or to commence the wedding ceremony.
Athens_058.name: Cupid

Athens_059.desc: I am Cupid's right hand man. Weddings should be exciting and fun. If you want to make a wedding go with a bang come don't forget to bring some red packets and fireworks!
Athens_059.name: Wedding Priest

Athens_060.desc: Come find me if you want to enter an instance! For a more challenging task, visit the Training Ground, but remember, you need to be at least level 40 to qualify.  For the ultimate adventure, join the Medusa Challenge, but you need to be at least level 90 to participate. It is a new instance which is located at sea. Great rewards, including Honor that can be exchanged for better items, await those with the courage to fight for them.
Athens_060.name: Instance Caller

Athens_061.desc: Zeus' lover has been kidnapped. Can you do the Thundergod a favor? I suppose Zeus can wait till you are level 50...
Athens_061.name: Labyrinth Quest Envoy

Athens_062.desc: Sicily has gone to hell, damned Hades! In order to purify and rebuild Sicily, we must destroy the inhuman monsters there.
Athens_062.name: Sicily Refugee

Athens_064.desc: During the Alpha Test, they bravely slaughtered monsters with the zeal of a veteran, while also fearlessly completing the most difficult quests. Athens_068.desc: Hey, come here! I have a wide range of goods. If you pay me with Bound Gold, I will give you some rare things.
Athens_068.name: B-GOLD Shop

Athens_069.desc: More and more people enter this ancient world everyday, but I am afraid they may get lost. When you've reached Level 50, you can apply to be a master and teach the newbies what you know, besides, they will receive special rewards from the Gods. One master can have up to 6 apprentices who are below Level 50. If they form a team, the master will gain Masters Ethics with the improvement of apprentices.
Athens_069.name: Teaching Manager

Athens_070.desc: Hephaestus is my master. Although I am not as skilful as him, I look more handsome. Yeah, I can help you enhance your gear, but don't tell my master.
Athens_070.name: Gear Mentor

Athens_071.desc: Hi, you can obtain your attribute and class titles from me! I will also reward you if you win some special titles!
Athens_071.name: Title Expert

Athens_072.desc: Labyrinth       Anytime                     50-140     Everyday Treasure Land   10:00pm - 11:00pm          60-140         Sun      Cursed Zone               any time          55-140       Everyday  Sicily           10:00pm - 12:00pm          25-140       Fri;     Pan's Labyrinth  12:00pm - 6:00pm          70-140      Weekends Trojan Expedition   8:00pm - 9:00pm        50-140      Thur      Romance Island   8:30pm - 9:00pm            70-140       Wed/Sat  You can also enter Sicily at any time with a Mystic Spell except Fridays. Athens_072.name: Event Transporter

Athens_073.desc: Please claim the rewards between 11:45am-11:55pm on Wednesdays and Sundays, and 9:45pm-11:55pm on Saturdays after the battlefield event ends.
Athens_073.name: Battlefield Awarder

Athens_074.desc: This is a Wishing Pool. It is said that it will grant player's wishes.
Athens_074.name: Wishing Pool

Athens_075.desc: As an oracle in touch with the divine power of the Gods, I can change your zodiac and grant you extraordinary luck for one day. However, I must use my divine power so the lucky time will be limited.
Athens_075.name: Fortune Teller

Athens_076.desc: You can hand in any war materials to me, but I won't pay much. However, you can send the war materials to War Supplier 2 in the suburbs or War Supplier 3 in Marathon and they may give you higher prices.
Athens_076.name: War Supplier 1

Athens_077.desc: If you have enough points, you can come find me and exchange for rewards that will help enhance your equipment.
Athens_077.name: Point Exchanger

Athens_078.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Athens_078.name: Fitness Trainer 6

Athens_079.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Athens_079.name: Fitness Trainer 7

Athens_080.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Athens_080.name: Fitness Trainer 8

Athens_081.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Athens_081.name: Fitness Trainer 9

Athens_082.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Athens_082.name: Fitness Trainer 10

Athens_083.desc: I am an old man. Don't ask where I'm from or where I'll go 'cuz I wouldn't tell you even if I knew. I am here to retrieve the Lost Book, so I will be able to give you one Sheepskin Scroll 7 everyday. You need to get the other scrolls from the Boogyman that respawns every 2 hrs in the surburbs. Beware their leaders, because they usually have a Sheepskin Scroll 7 on them. Follow the instructions on the scroll to find the corresponding Lost Book Chapters. Once you have collected them, I can help you piece them together into a fullversion of the Lost Book, and with it, you can obtain great rewards at the Wishing Pool.
Athens_083.name: Mysterious Elder

Athens_084.desc: I am the Festival Envoy, and during the festivities, players who reach Level 30 can come to me and claim a small gift. In addition, all players can come to me and claim EXP fun time every weekend.
Athens_084.name: Festival Envoy

Athens_085.desc: Don't call me Master Vestment Forger. Or else, I will be ashamed because the craft to forge vestments was invented by Hephaestus, the god of fire and metal-working, but I have merely mastered superficial knowledge of the craft.
Athens_085.name: Master Vestment Forger

Athens_086.desc: Hey, adventurer, have you ever heard the ana "The vestment that has not been improved by a holy stone is not a good vestment"? Errr, I've forgotten which celebrity first said that. Anyway, he is right. Why not improve your vestments with holy stones now?
Athens_086.name: Holy Stone Artisan

Athens_087.desc: I am selling good stuffs. Traveler, why not browse my goods? Just give me some  Bound Gold, I will give you some rare items in return. Don't tell this secret to others, okay?
Athens_087.name: Bound Gold Vendor

Athens_088.desc: I am a mage from Temple of Artemis on Delos Island. I'm able to communicate with pets. Bring me a pet, and I can help you prepare a Soul Contract, which allows you to merge a pet with another to concentrate their power, or allows your pet to be reborn; both paths are designed to strengthrn your pet. If you can get Pixie's Tear, I can reveal the pet's hidden growth rate. If you have Seal Jade (empty), I can seal your pet for trade if it hasn't been bounded to you.
Athens_088.name: Pet Manager

Athens_089.desc: Have you ever heard about the Sphinx? It's an Egyptian pharaoh's pet. Just browse my goods, I am able to make your pet even stronger than the Sphinx.
Athens_089.name: Pet Merchant

Athens_090.desc: Pan sent me here to assist those brave warriors who wish to visit his labyrinth! Give me all 6 invitation parts, and I will give you an invitation letter and a certificate that can be redeemed for a free gift!
Athens_090.name: Pan's Envoy

Athens_091.desc: I am Cupid's shadow. I'm always on the opposite side of Cupid. For example, I've been really busy lately handling applications for broken engagements and divorces. Ha-ha nothing lasts for ever!
Athens_091.name: Cupid's Shadow

Athens_092.desc: Happy Spring Festival! This year, Valentine's Day will be during Spring Festival. Love and renewal are in the air, but some annoying Snow Demons have begun attacking Sparta! The nerve of these beast! They have already reached the suburbs of Sparta. We must prevent them from invading the city! Brave adventurers, go destroy the  Snow Demons. They will drop a lot of cool stuff when killed that you can then exchange with me for cool rewards.
Athens_092.name: Spring Festival Envoy

Athens_093.desc: I give out the round quest.
Athens_093.name: [Round Quest]Main City Issuer

Athens_094.desc: Hello. You will benefit a lot from communicating with friends. Please left click on an NPC and choose a function from the user menu after clicking a player. You can click quest target to Auto-trace after accepting a quest. Is it easy?
Athens_094.name: [Newbie Guide]

Athens_095.desc: Haha, I have everything that you expect to find. Come and buy something!
Athens_095.name: [Props Merchant]Kuriakis

Athens_096.desc: Hi, warrior! I have all kinds of weapons for you to choose from.
Athens_096.name: [Warrior Supplier]Alexiou

Athens_097.desc: Forging gear is manual labor and inlaying is mental labor. If you are not careful, it will...Hephaestus is our Ironsmiths's patron saint. Lots of legendary weapons were made by him.
Athens_097.name: Nemodes

Athens_098.desc: Hello. There is no special event in the village today. When your level increases, you can accept a quest from the person who has a "question mark above their head".
Athens_098.name: Ion

Athens_099.desc: There are lots of monsters outside the newbie camp, trying to defeat them is the best training.
Athens_099.name: [Skill Merchant]Thisbe

Athens_100.desc: Warehouses can be used to deposit items, do you want to do so? Epeius has made a horse with much wood and the horse became the symbol of the Trojan Horse Club.
Athens_100.name: [Warehouse]Belen

Athens_101.desc: How are you, my dear friend?
Athens_101.name: Zander

Athens_102.desc: Prepare enough materials before fighting against monsters, so you can win. Are you ready? I have a variety of armor, have a look!
Athens_102.name: [Armor Merchant]Judaeus

Athens_103.desc: I am good at painting on pillars and walls.
Athens_103.name: Alns

Athens_104.desc: It is very important for a warrior to sustain physical strength.
Athens_104.name: Dorotheou

Athens_105.desc: You don't fight alone. Have you ever heard of the Trojan Horse Club? A tall Trojan Horse.
Athens_105.name: Homer

Athens_106.desc: I am a stranger, but I will give my helping hand if I am needed. If you see my old friend Pylades, please ask him to find me.
Athens_106.name: Acacia

Athens_107.desc: A wise scholar doesn't compete with others in strength.
Athens_107.name: [Scholar Supplier]Moya

Athens_108.desc: Tragedies are performed in the theater, I don't want to be a tragic heroine, I love my brothers and sisters. Have you ever been to Thebes?
Athens_108.name: [Jewelry Merchant]Antigone

Athens_109.desc: I am an apothecary.                                                To exchange gems or crystals for exp potions, or transfer potions, come see me.
Athens_109.name: Apothecary

Athens_110.desc: I am sent by Hera to distribute pet eggs to people of this world. Once you have an egg, click on it to hatch your baby pet.
Athens_110.name: Pet Master

Athens_111.desc: In order to enjoy a peaceful Spring Festival, we must defeat the Lunar Beast. This is not too difficult, but it is not without dangers. To get started we must first lure it out. People say the best way to lure this monster out from the shadows is with Spring Festival Firecrackers. This is where you come in. I need some special goods for Spring Festival, and if you bring them to me I will reward you with Spring Festival Firecrackers. If you want to learn more about how to find the Lunar Beast, talk with the Lunar Beast Slayer beside me.
Athens_111.name: Spring Merrymaker

Athens_112.desc: Great, now's my time to shine. First, get some Spring Festival Firecrackers from the Spring Merrymaker beside me. I will lure the Lunar Beast out when I've lit enough Spring Festival Firecrackers, then we can defeat it together. I'll even reward you for bringing it down. Do you want a fantastic Flying Carpet or a cute snowman?
Athens_112.name: Lunar Beast Slayer

Athens_113.desc: The Almighty Zeus rules over the Olympian Gods with wisdom and gives us strength. I am unable to give him anything in return, except my gratitude and loyal service. Would you like to do the same? Zeus will know of your devotion and give you blessings in return. Also, the more gifts you deliver, the greater the rewards - even double on the weekends! Just a hint, the  Cursed Zone  and  Treasure Land  have many of Zeus' favorite gifts.
Athens_113.name: [Event]Zeus' Loyal Believer

Athens_114.desc: Dear friend, you must always keep mind that without Zeus' blessings we cannot live a good life at all. During every  0:00PM Saturday and 11:55PM Sunday, Zeus always commands me to give out innumerous precious treasures, including a great deal of experience and talent points. If you want to get them, you must first offer Zeus Praying Stone.
Athens_114.name: [Event]Praying Saint

Athens_115.desc: Provide a Mid-autumn Festival Gift Pack Dollar to me, and you will get a great gift pack containing Level 2 Crystal*50,  Greater Pixie Bag*1,  Level 3 Ruby*3, Level 3 Sapphire *3, Level 3 Emerald *3, Energy Holy Water*10, 10 of each a variety of Enduring Potion, Golden Iris*20, Super Healing Potion*99,  Super Mana Potion*99, Mysterious String Bag *10, Super Firework*5, Anima Potion*10 and pieces of a Magic Jade of the rare Blue Crystal Dragon.
Athens_115.name: Mid-autumn Gift Pack Giver

Athens_116.desc: I am the best mount feeder in all of Greece. Just get your mount here in one piece, and I'll take care of the rest.
Athens_116.name: Mount Feeder

Athens_117.desc: Come on! Get those naughty  Bunnies for me! The Bunnies will spawn  Easter Eggs. Turn in the eggs to me for prizes. The prizes are available  1 hour  after the Bunny  turns up. An extra  Weak Bunny will go to the player who turns in the largest number of Easter Eggs. The prizes must be claimed before the next round of  Bunnies spawn, or they will be forfeited. Only  Lvl 20+ players are allowed participate in the Bunny busting event.
Athens_117.name: Easter Bunny Envoy

Athens_118.desc: You will receive a Quest Sack from me to complete the Scroll Quest. After the quest is complete you will be rewarded with an Exp Pill and a chance at a Morning Dew. Each round includes 10 quests, the more quests you complete the more rewards you will receive. After completing the 10th quest, you will be rewarded with an extra Talent Stone 3.
Athens_118.name: Random Quest Manager

Athens_119.desc: Hey, I am the envoy for IGG's special anniversary celebrations. Brave warrior, can you help me unlock the Treasure Chest? IGG has prepared big anniversary gifts!However, I dropped the key to the Treasure Chest by accident, and the key ended up several hundred pieces. I need you to retract some of  these pieces from Key Collector at Peloponnesus (73, -21)  or Marathon (81,63) . Be wary of the hostile Anniversary Chest Bandits who will assault whoever is holding a full set of pieces near the Anniversary Chest. Anniversary Chests need to be defended carefully, as those bandits are not pushovers.
Athens_119.name: IGG Anniversary Envoy

Athens_120.desc: There are 4 types of Professions in GodsWar Online,Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Mythcrafting and Scholarship. If you are unhappy with your current profession, you may unlearn it and start a new one, but  this will completely remove all traces of the former profession,including any skills or recipes associated with it. Please make sure this is acceptable before you unlearn a profession.
Athens_120.name: Profession Mentor

Athens_121.desc: Hey, come take a look at my goods! Best in all of Greece!
Athens_121.name: Alchemy Recipe Vendor

Athens_122.desc: Look here! Good Ingredients for sale at reasonable price.
Athens_122.name: Ingredients Vendors

Athens_123.desc: A convenient and thrilling chest where you claim the prizes (including B-GOLD) handed out by GM.
Athens_123.name: Prize Chest

Athens_124.desc: You can claim rewards from me after the event has closed.
Athens_124.name: Event Awarder

Athens_125.desc: Paris, the seductive prince of Troy, lured Helen away to the city of Troy.  Agamemnon, the great Greek leader has decided to launch an attack on Troy to get her back and teach the Trojans a lesson for their impudence.  All warriors in the land should join the fight for the glory of Greece!
Athens_125.name: Trojan War Coordinator

Athens_126.desc: A certain amount of wish-making credits is to be earned if you buy the selected items from the Item Mall before Sept 29th.      Before October 13th, you can use the earned wish-making credits to wish for the cool and rare items not available in the Item Mall. Your wish might come true with certain odds. Hesitate no further, and head over to win.
Athens_126.name: Carnival Envoy

Athens_127.desc: I am responsible for the security of traders and merchants here.     The Treasure Bandits have been stealing from more and more people over the past several weeks, and we cannot let it continue. They must be brought to justice. This is why we are empowering anyone brave enough to face them with the task of capturing them.
Athens_127.name: Treasury Official

Athens_128.desc: We’re introducing a fun new event in celebration of Easter! Click the Event Details button to find out more.
Athens_128.name: Easter Envoy

Athens_129.desc: I am the Rich Man Envoy. How about trying your luck here? Just hand over some Level 1 crystals to me for your chance to get rich quick!
Athens_129.name: Rich Man Envoy

Athens_130.desc: I am the Sacred Sealer:                                                                                                                  I have some scrolls that have legendary creatures sealed inside. With these scrolls, you can summon these beasts. Once they have been defeated, you can loot their treasure. Don't think for a moment these scrolls are free, do you know what I had to do to get them...? Actually it's better if I don't tell you. At any rate, you've got to cough up some Gold if you want one of these scrolls.
Athens_130.name: Sacred Sealer

Athens_131.desc: Everyone will be able to exchange up to 3 [Holy Stone Package Vouchers] with me for 3 bound [Holy Stone Packages]. One for one. [Holy Stone Package Vouchers] can be purchased from the [Item Mall] for only 1800 Gold. Each [Holy Stone Package Voucher] can be exchanged for one [Holy Stone Package] containing items worth up to 6,100 Gold.  If you have bought too many [Holy Stone Package Vouchers], you must return the unused ones for a refund . o learn how to use Holy Stones, check out our in-game tutorial here.[LINK to tutorial]
Athens_131.name: Holy Stone Redeemer

Athens_132.desc: Claim one Online Award per server day. Rewards are configured by the server and may change.
Athens_132.name: Online Award Admin

Athens_133.desc: B-Gold Trader  Greetings! I've made a fortune trading B-Gold, and if you would like to take advantage of my services, I'll give you 360 B-Gold in exchange for 180 Gold. Keep in mind I don't carry a lot of B-Gold with me, after all one can't be too careful these days, so I can only trade with each player once each day.Notes.    1.B-Gold binds when acquired. B-Gold can be used to purchase items from the [B-Gold vendor] and the [B-Gold shop] located in the area of (145,-137) in each of the main cities.2. Players can only exchange for B-Gold once each day.3. Players can only exchange for B-Gold between the hours of 12:00AM and 11:55PM each day.
Athens_133.name: B-Gold Trader

Athens_134.desc: With my help, you'll be able to open a lot more Storagee Boxes using the same amount of Storage Box Keys.
Athens_134.name: Warehouse Manager

Athens_135.desc: Hey, come take a look at my goods! Best in all of Greece!
Athens_135.name: Forging Recipe Vendor

Athens_136.desc: Hey, come take a look at my goods! Best in all of Greece!
Athens_136.name: Mythcrafting Recipe Vendor

Athens_137.desc: Hey, come take a look at my goods! Best in all of Greece!
Athens_137.name: Scholarship Recipe Vendor

Athens_138.desc: Do you want to change your gender? Don't just stand there staring, if you're not happy the way you are now, then tell me. Are you sure you want to change your gender?
Athens_138.name: Plastic Surgeon

Athens_139.desc: I know how troublesome it is to only be able to use items one at a time - as such, I've devised a way to enable batch usage of [Morning Dew I], [EXP Stone 3], and [Talent Stone 3]! Well, you can thank me later!
Athens_139.name: Personal Helper

Athens_140.desc: Hail, adventurer! I'm from faraway, and I deal in all kinds of exotic and fine wares. Take a look!
Athens_140.name: Mystery Merchant

Athens_141.desc: Do you want to change your faction? Don’t just stand there in silence; if you’re not satisfied with your current faction, let me know. Are you certain you want to switch factions?
Athens_141.name: Faction Changer

Athens_142.desc: Ah, a bold adventurer! If you’ve reached the Level 89, would you like me to seal your level? Once sealed, you’ll remain at 89 but can still gain experience. This is useful for honing your skills and earning rewards without leveling up further. Think carefully—once sealed, you’ll be locked at this level until you choose to unseal. If you’re ready, let me know, and I’ll take care of the rest.
Athens_142.name: Level Sealer

Athens_143.desc: I may not be as skilled as Hephaestus, but I know how to make your gear shine. Whether it’s your mount or your wardrobe, I can enhance them to perfection. Just don't expect my master to approve of my... extra flair."
Athens_143.name: Origin Enhancer

Athens_Newbie_001.desc: Do you know how to tame an animal into a pet? Listen to me, it's so easy, all you need is the right tool.
Athens_Newbie_001.name: Farmer Yannis

Athens_Newbie_002.desc: Oh, no, my farmland has been almost completely destroyed.
Athens_Newbie_002.name: Farmer Kiron

Athens_Newbie_003.desc: Please help me get back to the fishing village to help my people. It is currently being occupied by a horde of evil monsters.
Athens_Newbie_003.name: Fisher Hamon

Athens_Newbie_004.desc: When you hit a new level, you will be able to learn new spells from some items. You can loot these items from monsters or they can be purchased from the Mall. Once you've gained a new spell, remember to press the S key to unfold your spell panel and drag the spell into the action bar for quick use.
Athens_Newbie_004.name: [Skill]Jenna

Athens_Newbie_005.desc: I am busy inspecting everyone and everything. You wouldn't believe how corrupt and evil everyone is. But I will continue to work hard to bring peace and justice to this beautiful land.
Athens_Newbie_005.name: Inspector Galen

Athens_Newbie_006.desc: There are several tough criminals on the wanted list. Do you dare to attempt to capture any of them?

Athens_Newbie_016.name: [Props]Catherine

Athens_Newbie_017.desc: I plan to participate in the Sports Competition in Olympia. But Olympia belongs to Elis Polis now. The king of Elis wants to sign a peace treaty with Sparta during the competition. The torch relay is mysterious and superb...I excel in the marathon and archery.
Athens_Newbie_017.name: Olympics Competitor

Athens_Newbie_018.desc: If you are level 0-75, then I can send you to some |cffF1418special Newbie practicing maps between |cffF1418 8:00pmto9:00pm every day.
Athens_Newbie_018.name: Newbie Events Transporter

Athens_Newbie_019.desc: I am sent by Hera to distribute pet eggs to people of this world. Once you have an egg, click on it to hatch your baby pet.
Athens_Newbie_019.name: Pet Master

Athens_Newbie_020.desc: When you reach level 10, come to me to claim some gear. You will be rewarded every 5 levels from Level 10 to Level 40.
Athens_Newbie_020.name: Gear Giver

Athens_Newbie_021.desc: Ha-ha, happy holidays! I only appear on special holidays. Don't miss out the gifts I am giving away!
Athens_Newbie_021.name: Gift Envoy

Athens_Newbie_022.desc: Warrior, when you reach Level 3, 15 and 31, come talk with me and I will teach a bit more as well as give you rewards for working so hard.
Athens_Newbie_022.name: Instructor

Athens_Newbie_023.desc: I won't accept the materials until you give it to me while in a team with 5 people. Different materials will bring you different rewards.  Certainly, you can also hand in materials to War Supplier 1 in the main city or War Supplier 3 in Marathon.
Athens_Newbie_023.name: War Supplier 2

Athens_Newbie_024.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to attend the round-the-city race 12:00am-11:55pm, every Monday through Saturday. You are allowed to join the race up to  6 times  a day! You will be rewarded 180 B-GOLD each the first two races in a day, and 90 B-GOLD for every race thereafter that day.
Athens_Newbie_024.name: Fitness Trainer 1

Athens_Newbie_025.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!

Derveni_All_001.desc: Are you tired of fighting, my warrior? What do you need? I like eating olives.
Derveni_All_001.name: [Props]Alexia

Derveni_All_002.desc: Use sedge as the book carrier. Great scholars love recording history and spreading philosophy.
Derveni_All_002.name: Sedge Merchant

Derveni_All_003.desc: Achaean people are the bravest soldiers in Greece. Our leader is Achilles.
Derveni_All_003.name: Achaeans Soldier

Derveni_All_004.desc: Tiryns is a town of Peloponnesus and next to Mycenae.
Derveni_All_004.name: Tiryns Elder

Derveni_All_005.desc: My father Sthenleus drove Amphitryon out of Argo.
Derveni_All_005.name: Eurystheus

Derveni_All_006.desc: Athena deprived my son of his sight as a punishment for peering at her while bathing. It was useless for Chariclo to beg Athena to take the curse away.
Derveni_All_006.name: Everes

Derveni_All_007.desc: We Electryon family and Tereus family are all later generations of Perseus, but our relationship is not good. Because Poseidon planted a piece of golden hair on Tereus, so Tereus became immortal, but his sons went back for their grandfather's property, so we fought each other, and only one person was left in each family.
Derveni_All_007.name: Lynceus

Derveni_All_008.desc: You can submit poisons to me in an attempt to assassinate the hostile Consul.
Derveni_All_008.name: Athenian Assassin

DuelArena_001.desc: After the logistics are developed, I will suggest they form a Federal Trade Bank. Thus,the Atticas Alliance in Athens will become stronger.
DuelArena_001.name: [Warehouse] Akou

Larissa_All_001.desc: I come from Delphi. Have you ever been to the Temple of Apollo there?
Larissa_All_001.name: Phorbas

Larissa_All_002.desc: I am a white poplar. My annual rings record human history.
Larissa_All_002.name: Amphissus

Larissa_All_003.desc: My polis Calydon often holds a Boar Hunt. I will invite all Greek warriors to join in it. I came here for Dionysus grapevine.
Larissa_All_003.name: Oeneus

Larissa_All_004.desc: Aetolia is the opposite polis of Athens and Sparta in Greece.
Larissa_All_004.name: Thestios

Larissa_All_005.desc: I will ride my horse flying to Olympus...Even Zeus cannot stop me!
Larissa_All_005.name: Bellerophon

Larissa_All_006.desc: Bellerophon adopted this name after he killed his brother by mistake.
Larissa_All_006.name: Mysterious Priest

Larissa_All_007.desc: My father rode Pegasus and defeated the Chimera in Lycia.
Larissa_All_007.name: Laodamia

Larissa_All_008.desc: Lycia lies on the Anatolia Plateau. Solymi and the Amazons live nearby. I will go on an expedition there with my father.
Larissa_All_008.name: Isandros

Larissa_All_009.desc: Although my father is brave, he hates war. I plan to help the Trojans fight the Greeks.
Larissa_All_009.name: Hippolochus

Larissa_All_010.desc: Atalanta is wild but beautiful. Her accurate archery is as good as any male warrior.
Larissa_All_010.name: Meleager

Larissa_All_011.desc: My father Meleager is famous as a warrior from Calydon to Aetolia.
Larissa_All_011.name: [Props]Althaea

Larissa_All_012.desc: Go on an expedition! An expedition! When will we get to our hometown Acadia?
Larissa_All_012.name: Ancaeus

Larissa_All_013.desc: Ancaeus is my father. I will take part in the Calydon Boar Hunt this year.
Larissa_All_013.name: Agapenor

Larissa_All_014.desc: Have you seen Ajax.E and Ajax? The name "Ajax" was coined by my friend Hercules.
Larissa_All_014.name: Telamon

Larissa_All_016.desc: After Jason left, I became the king of Iolcus.
Larissa_All_016.name: Acastus

Larissa_All_017.desc: I really need a break to eat some delicious turkey.
Larissa_All_017.name: Tired Visitor

Larissa_All_018.desc: Jason left me in the care of Chiron. I grow in the mountain and know how to protect myself.
Larissa_All_018.name: Medeus

Larissa_All_019.desc: Hah, I am called the fox... Where is my servant?
Larissa_All_019.name: [Warrior]Snow Fox

Larissa_All_020.desc: Pigeons are flying lightly...On such a snowy day, do you want to see some dazzling magic?
Larissa_All_020.name: [Scholar]White Pigeon

Larissa_All_021.desc: At the foot of the mountain, an old bear becomes a genius...Have you ever heard the fable of the bear princess? A brown bear negotiated with a hunter. The hunter said,"I only want your fur coat." The bear said, "I just want something to eat." So the bear ate the hunter, satisfying its hunger, and the hunter also got the fur coat he desired.
Larissa_All_021.name: [Skill]Centuried Bear

Larissa_All_023.desc: We have a wide business region. If there are any problems please visit our website. Thank you.
Larissa_All_023.name: [Warehouse] Origin

Lelantine_Farm_001.desc: Damn, those wild dogs are so annoying. They've completely destroyed my vineyard. I will never forgive them. Greek warriors, I will give you some tuck nets. Please capture all of them.
Lelantine_Farm_001.name: Sorehead Ninto

Lelantine_Farm_002.desc: Wow, what cute doggies! I love them so much. I really don't understand why Ninto hates them. Isn't is nice to see them running around? By the way, traveler, can you tame some doggies for me? I've got some nice rewards prepared.
Lelantine_Farm_002.name: Delighted Kelsis

Lelantine_Farm_003.desc: The evil stalkers have wreaked havoc in Lelantine recently. They've been attacking creatures and demolishing crops. The Euboea High Priest hopes we'll send troops to eliminate them. Brave Athenians have never declined a friendly request from allies especially when we need to offer large quantities of quality Euboea grape wine to the Hieron. It's said the Spartans are ready to do something too, but I don't believe they will be able to eliminate the stalkers. The truth will come out and everyone will know that the Athenias are the most powerful city-state in Greece.
Lelantine_Farm_003.name: Athenian Advance Troop Captain

Lelantine_Farm_004.desc: Lelantine used to be so beautiful! Those hateful stalkers have destroyed it. I am offering tons of tuck nets to whoever can capture them – all of them!
Lelantine_Farm_004.name: Athenian Quartermaster

Lelantine_Farm_005.desc: The advance force has kept in close contact with the main city. We can send you there instantly.
Lelantine_Farm_005.name: Returning Helper

Lelantine_Farm_006.desc: The evil stalkers have wreaked havoc in Lelantine recently. They've been attacking creatures and demolishing crops. The Euboea High Priest hopes we'll send troops to eliminate them and we are looking to pick up large quantities of high quality Euboea grape wine for the sacrifice. It's said the Euboea High Priest also asked the boy toy Athenians for help. Ha-ha, have you ever heard something so funny!? How can the pathetic Athenians beat those stalkers? Us Spartans are going to put them down and show the Athenians how real warriors get things done!
Lelantine_Farm_006.name: Spartan Advance Troop Captain

Lelantine_Farm_007.desc: Lelantine used to be so beautiful! Those hateful stalkers have destroyed it. I am offering tons of tuck nets to whoever can capture them – all of them!
Lelantine_Farm_007.name: Spartan Quartermaster

Marathon_All_001.desc: You are coming. A good day, isn't it? But I feel something is missing...
Marathon_All_001.name: Spyridon

Marathon_All_002.desc: My little sister Circe snuck away to play, and now I can't find her...
Marathon_All_002.name: Penelope

Marathon_All_003.desc: You can visit the splendid temple in the main city. Every year there are lots of people involved in the sacrificial ceremony. It is said that Athena will befall near us.

Marathon_All_006.desc: I am patrolling, what are you doing?

Marathon_All_007.desc: I like charging in the front.

Marathon_All_008.desc: A lot of soldiers have been arriving recently, will there be a war?

Marathon_All_009.desc: Hey, various medicines are available. Gods bless you!

Medusa_Island2_001.desc: I can't remember how long I've been here, nor can I remember the number of criminals this place housed over the years. You can leave this place early if you can pass my 3 tests, or else, you will serve your term here with me.
Medusa_Island2_001.name: Correction Officer

Medusa_Island_001.desc: You are welcome to help! Before dealing with Medusa, we must first clear out all the monsters along the way. There are monsters hiding on all 3 paths to the isolated island, with the level of difficulty varying from path to path. Please choose the most suitable path for yourself, and remember the more you kill, the better the rewards. When you reach the end of the path, you will see Medusa - then defeat her!
Medusa_Island_001.name: Perseus

Megara_All_001.desc: I must defend my country, why not come with me? Megara and Elosmith Town are Athens' allies.
Megara_All_001.name: Iphicrades

Megara_All_002.desc: Oh, the oracle says: You are a good man.
Megara_All_002.name: Serafim

Megara_All_003.desc: It's hasn't been safe recently. I hope the war will be over soon. I hope the Gods are watching over us on Olympus.
Megara_All_003.name: Eyfimias

Megara_All_004.desc: What a fine day! Why not go hunting outdoors?
Megara_All_004.name: Sebastiane

Megara_All_005.desc: It must be much faster to deliver letters with a carriage, but now the carriages are widely used in battles.
Megara_All_005.name: Postman

Megara_All_006.desc: Contentment brings happiness. Look at these oaks, they grow well with much rainwater.
Megara_All_006.name: [Props]Philemon

Megara_All_007.desc: I will guide people of Megara to the east and develop new territory. It is said that there is a wide land to the north of Lydia and to the east of Thrace. It's also the place to which the Olympian gods are paying attention.
Megara_All_007.name: Byzas

Megara_All_008.desc: Greeks are good at writing poetry, such as dirges, battle songs and love songs.
Megara_All_008.name: Theognis

Megara_All_009.desc: Elosmith...mystery... Elosmith town often holds sacrificial ceremonies.
Megara_All_009.name: Elosmith Clergyman

Megara_All_010.desc: What kind of things haven't I seen?
Megara_All_010.name: Fisherman

Megara_All_011.desc: Apollo sent the plague. Agamemnon and his attendants will pay for it.
Megara_All_011.name: Chruses

Megara_All_012.desc: I am Orestes's servant. Did you see him? He is great, I will follow him forever.
Megara_All_012.name: Pylades

Megara_All_013.desc: Exchange Sheepskin Scroll 7 for Lost Book Chapter 7.
Megara_All_013.name: Ancient Relics 7

Megara_All_014.desc: I am the best physician in Greece. What can I do for you?
Megara_All_014.name: Athenian Physician

Megara_All_015.desc: From 7:00pm through 9:00pm on Fridays, you can claim some deadly poisons from me and then turn it over to an Assassin with the mission of taking down the hostile Consul. You can even choose to do it yourself, which is more rewarding but more risky. Megara_All_015.name: Athenian Apothecary

Megara_All_016.desc: Hey brave warrior, I am the Athenian Consul. What have you got to contribute?
Megara_All_016.name: Athenian Consul

Megara_All_017.desc: You can submit poisons to me in an attempt to assassinate the hostile Consul.
Megara_All_017.name: Spartan Assassin

Mycenae_All_001.desc: I am Nestor. Neleus is my father.
Mycenae_All_001.name: Nestor

Mycenae_All_002.desc: My father is Nestor. I am in command of a large contingent of troops.
Mycenae_All_002.name: Thrasymedes

Mycenae_All_003.desc: Machaon is my brother. Hopefully I can become a great surgeon like him one day.
Mycenae_All_003.name: Podaleirios

Mycenae_All_004.desc: I should wear a hood and a cloak so I look like a traveling surgeon.
Mycenae_All_004.name: Telesphoros

Mycenae_All_005.desc: Have you ever been to Cyprus? It is an extraordinary isle located off the southeast coast in the Mediterranean sea.
Mycenae_All_005.name: Hygea

Mycenae_All_006.desc: Chiron has taught me many healing methods. Collecting the correct herbs to apply to wounds is critical. The wound will heal quickly.
Mycenae_All_006.name: Asclepius

Mycenae_All_007.desc: The Hotsprings are very effective in pacifying souls and healing scars. So I believe building a statue beside the hotsprings will help calm people's souls even more.
Mycenae_All_007.name: Epione

Mycenae_All_008.desc: All talented surgeons walk with aid of intricate staves. They are very useful, and boy, do they look cool!
Mycenae_All_008.name: Aceso

Mycenae_All_009.desc: My parents were Zeus and Europa. I constantly travel all over Mycenae. Rhadamanthus is my brother. He is in Thebes right now.
Mycenae_All_009.name: Sarpedon

Mycenae_All_010.desc: Want a massage? I rub you long time.
Mycenae_All_010.name: Physician

Mycenae_All_011.desc: Have you ever heard of Andromeda, the Ethiopian princess? People created a statue for her along the coast.
Mycenae_All_011.name: [Props]Meryl

Mycenae_All_012.desc: The churchwomen of Dionysus really enjoy hosting carnivals on Cithaero.
Mycenae_All_012.name: [Warehouse]Kurd

Mycenae_All_014.desc: Greetings Traveler, I can help you travel back to Thebes or teleport further up to Larissa.
Mycenae_All_014.name: Transporter

Nemea_1_001.desc: I will never give up halfway for my brothers!
Nemea_1_001.name: Antilochos

Nemea_1_002.desc: Did you see Eurubaies? He is strange recently. Chiron is a sage, I think it's necessary to ask him to cure Eurubaies with some herbs.
Nemea_1_002.name: Automedon

Nemea_1_004.desc: What can I do for you? You cannot spread ointment randomly, you must disinfect the scar first.
Nemea_1_004.name: Pit

Nemea_1_005.desc: I hope I can open his chest, observe his thoughts and close it. So I can know if he is my friend or not ... This is an anonym's poem.
Nemea_1_005.name: Thoma

Nemea_1_006.desc: You're too young to drink! Get out of here before I call the guard...and your mother!
Nemea_1_006.name: Theklas

Nemea_1_010.desc: This country is in danger, but we still have hopes as we have a younger generation like you.
Nemea_1_010.name: Captain

Nemea_1_011.desc: Oh, my god! Who will protect our village?
Nemea_1_011.name: Village Head

Nemea_1_013.desc: It is said that Egyptian Phoenixes will rise from their ashes. My name is related with that immortal bird.
Nemea_1_013.name: Phoenix

Nemea_1_014.desc: I have some cheap but good things. Please take a look.
Nemea_1_014.name: [Props]Prothoos

Nemea_1_015.desc: Do you want to deposit things? The warehouse can store lots of materials. It seems there will be a war, now is the time to safely store your valuables.
Nemea_1_015.name: [Warehouse]Manager

Nemea_1_016.desc: Want to be an advanced warrior? Don't forget to update your gear!
Nemea_1_016.name: [Warrior]Diores

Nemea_1_018.desc: Choose a piece of gear to protect you and decrease the damge caused by monsters. Perseus's helmet which can make him invisible is famous in Gods War Online, but it belonged to Hades before.
Nemea_1_018.name: [Armor]Tuchios

Nemea_1_019.desc: I want to make ornaments with orchis. Spiranthes is a orchis name.
Nemea_1_019.name: [Jewelry]Spiranthes

Nemea_1_020.desc: Hi, friend. Do you want to improve your fighting ability? Practise with me.
Nemea_1_020.name: [Skill]Poluboites

Nemea_1_021.desc: Athena can transform into a person. Maybe she is hiding among us.
Nemea_1_021.name: Telemachos

Nemea_1_022.name: Transporter

Nemea_2_002.name: [Daily Quest]Forest Issuer

Nemea_2_003.desc: Fight for Sparta. Long live Sparta!
Nemea_2_003.name: Eurybia

Nemea_2_004.desc: The 12 constellations have something to do with the gods.
Nemea_2_004.name: Thales

Nemea_2_005.desc: Math is not only a study of numbers but also a demonstration of wisdom.
Nemea_2_005.name: Pythagoras

Olympia_All_001.desc: Such large scale sports competitions can only be found in Elis. Come to join us. I hope to make competitive sports more popular to the south of Pisa or even the whole of Greece.
Olympia_All_001.name: Oenomaus

Olympia_All_002.desc: I want to make an olive wreath for our hero with a triumphant smile on his face.
Olympia_All_002.name: Hippodamia

Olympia_All_003.desc: Have you ever heard of Lydia which is my hometown. I took part in competitive sports at Olympia when I was still young. I was pretty good at Carriage and Harness Racing
Olympia_All_003.name: Pelops

Olympia_All_004.desc: My father will come back to take part in the sports competition every four years.
Olympia_All_004.name: Chrysippus

Olympia_All_005.desc: I have twin daughters. They are as adorable as Daphne. They have admirers throughout the whole of Acadia. I believe this will put my daughters' names on everybody's lips when they come of age.
Olympia_All_005.name: Leucippus

Olympia_All_006.desc: Clio gave birth to my nine daughters. All of them are art fans.
Olympia_All_006.name: Pierus

Olympia_All_007.desc: Art and sports are equally important. We are writing a song that will be performed at the opening ceremony for the Olympia sports competition.
Olympia_All_007.name: Pierides

Olympia_All_008.desc: Apollo has picked my son Hyacinthus. We must send him to Olympia. But it hurts me whenever I think that my son will be far away from me, from Laconia the place where he was born and grew up.
Olympia_All_008.name: Amyclas

Olympia_All_009.desc: My father is Leucippus. Phoebe is my little twin sister. She was named after Phoebe who is the Titan goddess of "bright" intellect.
Olympia_All_009.name: Hilaeira

Olympia_All_010.desc: My father is Leucippus. Hilaeira is my big twin sister. She is now crazy about a guy called Pollux.
Olympia_All_010.name: Phoebe

Olympia_All_011.desc: Wow, get them, get them. It must be fair competition. Men must die on the battlefield. Why not join the Argo Volunteer Club.
Olympia_All_011.name: Kastor

Olympia_All_012.desc: Hilaeira is so beautiful. Phoebe is her twin sister. But I have more feelings for her.
Olympia_All_012.name: Pollux

Olympia_All_013.desc: Kastor is really arrogant. This annoying outsider even wanted to rob me of my cow. I must teach him a lesson with my spear.
Olympia_All_013.name: Idas

Olympia_All_014.desc: Can you see through this rock. People here are calling me Sharp Eyes.I am the best pilot in the Argo Volunteer Club.
Olympia_All_014.name: Lynkeus

Olympia_All_015.desc: I am from Mysia in Anatolia Plateau. My home country is in the vicinity of Lydia, Lycia and Troy.
Olympia_All_015.name: Cypaissus

Olympia_All_016.desc: There are two fish swimming in this river. They are the incarnations of Aphrodite and Eros.
Olympia_All_016.name: Daphne

Olympia_All_017.desc: I am a dreamer. I want Iris' to be growing everwhere at Olympia and the faraway Eastern.
Olympia_All_017.name: Florentina

Olympia_All_018.desc: Do you want to take part in a sports competition?
Olympia_All_018.name: Athlete

Olympia_All_019.desc: The Ionian Sea lies to the west of Elijah. Fish in the sea are the gifts from Poseidon.
Olympia_All_019.name: Elijah Hunter

Olympia_All_020.desc: You must keep yourself at your best. We count on you to bring news of victory to us.
Olympia_All_020.name: [Props]Bernice

Olympia_All_021.desc: We will hold a torch lighting and torch relay ceremony. Zeus and Hera are watching us!
Olympia_All_021.name: Churchy Female Priest

Olympia_All_022.desc: The Olympic Games will spread to the east. Do you believe that?
Olympia_All_022.name: [Scholar]Believer

Olympia_All_023.desc: My master is good at various sports.
Olympia_All_023.name: [Warrior]Servant

Olympia_All_024.desc: There are lots of relics in Olympia. Have you learnt the skill of praying to gods?
Olympia_All_024.name: [Skill]Agent

Olympia_All_025.desc: Have you seen my daughters? I will make them dress up and look beautiful!
Olympia_All_025.name: [Jewelry]Clio

Olympia_All_026.desc: Greetings, we are express deliverers. It is our pleasure to help you deliver anything.
Olympia_All_026.name: [Warehouse]Origin Express

Parnitha_1_001.desc: I will never give up halfway through! This is for my brothers!
Parnitha_1_001.name: Bias

Parnitha_1_002.desc: Did you see Philander? He is strange recently. Machaon is Aesculapius's son, I think it's necessary to ask him to examine Philander.
Parnitha_1_002.name: Telemachus

Parnitha_1_004.desc: What can I do for you? I am a Wolf Killer.
Parnitha_1_004.name: Ctesias

Parnitha_1_005.desc: Compared with the gods, it's better to sit with you face to face. What a pleasant thing to listen to you... This is an anonym's poem.
Parnitha_1_005.name: Phaedrus

Parnitha_1_007.desc: Hi, I have heard of you.
Parnitha_1_007.name: Aiputos

Parnitha_1_008.desc: I have some cheap but good quality things. Please take a look. My father asked me to open a medicine business on the road before the war. I think it's a good idea.
Parnitha_1_008.name: [Props]Machaon

Parnitha_1_009.desc: I will keep things for you. You can continue on your journey with ease.
Parnitha_1_009.name: [Warehouse]Manager

Parnitha_1_010.desc: Want to be an advanced warrior? Don't forget to update your gear!
Parnitha_1_010.name: [Warrior]Eurualos

Parnitha_1_012.desc: Choose a piece of gear to protect you and decrease the damage caused by monsters. Athena's Aegis is famous in Gods War Online.
Parnitha_1_012.name: [Armor]Prothoenor

Parnitha_1_013.desc: Aphrodite gave a necklace to Cadmus and Harmonia as a wedding gift. As the necklace will bring disaster to people, it is not for sale.
Parnitha_1_013.name: [Jewelry]Jocasta

Parnitha_1_014.desc: Haha, you are coming. There are many mountain paths near Parnitha. Going on an expedition is very difficult.
Parnitha_1_014.name: Orestes

Parnitha_1_015.desc: Hey, you scared me. More and more monster have appeared out of the village.
Parnitha_1_015.name: Guard

Parnitha_1_016.desc: This country is in danger, but we still have hopes as we have a younger generation to look forward to like you.
Parnitha_1_016.name: Captain

Parnitha_1_017.desc: Oh, my god! Who will protect our village?
Parnitha_1_017.name: Village Head

Parnitha_1_018.desc: Ouch! When will Machaon send medicine to us?
Parnitha_1_018.name: Wounded Guard

Parnitha_1_019.desc: It is said that there is a bigger sphinx near Med. I don't know how many questions she will ask me. By the way, I will tell you a secret: I have seen a small sphinx before, she asked me three questions!
Parnitha_1_019.name: Oedipus

Parnitha_1_020.desc: Hi, child. Do you want to improve your fighting ability? Practice with me.
Parnitha_1_020.name: [Skill]Novoross

Parnitha_1_021.desc: When can I go back to Peloponnesus with my father?
