Parnitha_2_004.desc: History is a record of the flow of time, but I don't merely study time.
Parnitha_2_004.name: Herodotus

Parnitha_2_005.desc: Keeping Parnitha Port safe is fundamental to resisting the Persian invaders.
Parnitha_2_005.name: Ephialtes

Peloponnese_All_001.desc: You are coming. A good day, isn't it? But I feel like something is missing...
Peloponnese_All_001.name: Varnava

Peloponnese_All_002.desc: My younger sister Teresa likes going out and now I cannot find her.
Peloponnese_All_002.name: Annis

Peloponnese_All_003.desc: You can visit the splendid temple in the main city. Brave people will receive the gods'oracle.
Peloponnese_All_003.name: Basileiou

Peloponnese_All_006.desc: I am patrolling, what are you doing?
Peloponnese_All_006.name: Meges

Peloponnese_All_007.desc: I like charging in the front.
Peloponnese_All_007.name: Muropis

Peloponnese_All_008.desc: A lot of soldiers have been arriving recently, will there be a war?
Peloponnese_All_008.name: Gerasimou

Peloponnese_All_009.desc: Hey, various medicines are available. Do you need some?
Peloponnese_All_009.name: [Props]Aithra

Peloponnese_All_010.desc: You should submit War Material 1 through War Material 4 in sequence together with your guild members. After that, you will obtain rewards. In addition, your guild will obtain extra rewards. You can also hand in the materials to War Supplier 1 in the main city or War Supplier 2 in the suburbs of Sparta.
Peloponnese_All_010.name: War Supplier 3

Peloponnese_All_011.desc: Exchange Sheepskin Scroll 2 for Lost Book Chapter 2.
Peloponnese_All_011.name: Ancient Relics 2

Peloponnese_All_012.desc: Exchange Sheepskin Scroll 5 for Lost Book Chapter 5.
Peloponnese_All_012.name: Ancient Relics 5

Peloponnese_All_013.desc: If you have more Cadian Plates, feel free to exchange them with me for experience points.
Peloponnese_All_013.name: [Spartan Cadian] General Lykaios

Peloponnese_All_014.desc: I've collected some pieces of the key. You can claim them during the event time, and then use them to unlock the IGG Anniversary Chest.                                                           Location of the IGG Anniversary Envoy                          Sparta (158,69)                                                      Athens (158,69)
Peloponnese_All_014.name: Key Collector

Plataea_All_001.desc: Hi, warrior, what do you need? Palm can be used to make oilseed.
Plataea_All_001.name: [Props]Alex

Plataea_All_002.desc: Good sheepskin can be used to make durable scrolls.
Plataea_All_002.name: Fellmonger

Plataea_All_003.desc: Thrace is a wide area in the northeast of Greece. Many tribes are living there and lots of people have noble Greek blood.
Plataea_All_003.name: Thracian Mercenary

Plataea_All_004.desc: Ismene is Antigone's sister. All Cadmeia people know they are good sisters.
Plataea_All_004.name: Cronus Captain

Plataea_All_005.desc: Sthenleus dispelled me out of my homeland. Luckily, all my children become heroes.
Plataea_All_005.name: Amphitryon

Plataea_All_006.desc: My wife Procris has a gundog which belonged to Minos before.
Plataea_All_006.name: Cephalus

Plataea_All_007.desc: I got a wizard spear from Minos. Minos has many brothers but he has driven them away from Crete.
Plataea_All_007.name: Procris

Plataea_All_008.desc: You can submit poisons to me in an attempt to assassinate the hostile Consul.
Plataea_All_008.name: Spartan Assassin

Sicily_003.desc: Welcome to Sicily, please choose a place suitable for you.
Sicily_003.name: Athenian Quest Envoy

Sicily_004.desc: Welcome to Sicily, please choose a place suitable for you.
Sicily_004.name: Spartan Quest Envoy

Sicily_005.desc: Alas, I don't know who I am or where I was from either. My task is to deliver these  Mystic Seals to brave persons who come here. These Mystic Seals initiate  a quest that rewards tons of talent points.
Sicily_005.name: Sicily Merchant

Sicily_006.desc: Alas, I don't know who I am or where I was from either. My task is to deliver these  Mystic Seals to brave persons who come here. These Mystic Seals initiate  a quest that rewards tons of talent points.
Sicily_006.name: Sicily Merchant

Sparta_001.desc: Improving the public order should be your top priority right now.
Sparta_001.name: Pelagias

Sparta_002.desc: Hey,what can I do for you? I am Captain, although it's a junior military title in Sparta, I love my job.
Sparta_002.name: Asteriou

Sparta_003.desc: What can I do for you? I am patrolling. I'll tell you a secret: The vendors in the logistical distribution center are all sea fairies. Nereus has 50 daughters.
Sparta_003.name: Nathanail

Sparta_004.desc: Do you want to listen to my melody?... It would be better if I have a lyre.
Sparta_004.name: Zeno

Sparta_005.desc: I am searching for various flower seeds. In Greece, many flower names have their own history.
Sparta_005.name: Eeria

Sparta_006.desc: If there is no law, the world would fall into anarchy...Sparta Parliament have various rights over the king. If the king breaks the law, he will also be punished.
Sparta_006.name: Claudios

Sparta_007.desc: I will be a great man like my teacher.
Sparta_007.name: Kleopatras

Sparta_008.desc: Technic has no borders. I hope all Greek craftsmen can unite and build the greatest building and statue.
Sparta_008.name: Ikaros

Sparta_009.desc: Sparta is a city with a long history. Peloponnesus is mountainous and our city is located in the crevice. It seems we have natural protection.
Sparta_009.name: Amvrosiou

Sparta_010.desc: Hi, I haven't seen you before... Do you want some wine? Wini Wine is very popular now.
Sparta_010.name: Petara

Sparta_011.desc: The Olympian gods bless you... All gods are relatives of 99Zeus, but they don't get along very good.
Sparta_011.name: [Priest]Diotima

Sparta_012.desc: Happy Thanksgiving Day, my brave fighters! Could you bring me some turkey meat and Thanksgiving Gift Certificates? If you do, I will reward you handsomely. If you also bring me one Thanksgiving Greetings Card, you will get even more rewards. Go ahead, there are a lot of turkeys just waiting for you to chase them in the Peloponnese_All.
Sparta_012.name: Thanksgiving Envoy

Sparta_013.desc: Have you ever found treasures? If you know some clues, please tell me! I like geological prospecting. The king of Mycenae has a Golden Mask, but I don't know where it is.
Sparta_013.name: Stamatis

Sparta_014.desc: Er, haven't I seen you before? You are a newcomer, right?...
Sparta_014.name: Gorgias

Sparta_015.desc: Don't touch me. It's not interesting here.
Sparta_015.name: Helen

Sparta_016.desc: When you decide to love someone, don't let them go. My dear Medea is not happy recently and has gone to Athens. I must get her back. Any good ideas?
Sparta_016.name: Jason

Sparta_017.desc: Which god do you like? Have you seen Nefen's Servant? They all live in hotspring.
Sparta_017.name: Atalanta

Sparta_018.desc: Doing the legwork is very tired, but I think it's interesting, because I can make more friends.
Sparta_018.name: Postman

Sparta_019.desc: Sparta is a good place. So is Athens to the northeast of Sparta. But they are engaged in war now.
Sparta_019.name: Achilles

Sparta_020.desc: A sage must be wise and never give up!
Sparta_020.name: [Sage]Neo

Sparta_021.desc: We are like beautiful flowers looking at Apollo's light! Brightening the whole Laconia Plain.
Sparta_021.name: Hyacinthus

Sparta_022.desc: Do you want to store items? If you don't have enough space in your backpack, why not deposit them here?
Sparta_022.name: [Warehouse]Manager

Sparta_023.desc: After the logistics develop, I will suggest they form the Peloponnesus Trade Bank. Thus,the Military Alliance in Sparta will become stronger.
Sparta_023.name: [Warehouse]Haides

Sparta_024.desc: The Guild instance is currently not active.
Sparta_024.name: [Guild] Instance Supervisor

Sparta_025.desc: Welcome, to our Mooncake Exchange this Mid-Autumn Festival!                Hail, my friend! I come a long way from the East, and I must say I have definite interest in Greek cuisine! Do you happen to have a Greek Cuisine Recipe with you? If not, I know a few ways you could get one! 1) At 2:00AM, 6:00AM, 10:00AM, 2:00PM, 6:00PM and 10:00PM daily, the Artemis Treasure Chest Leader will appear in the wilds - defeat him to get one!  2) Exchange Delicate Mooncakes with the Lunar Priest, and you might get one too!             If you already have a Greek Cuisine Recipe, you can exchange it with me for a Delicate Mooncake quest scroll!
Sparta_025.name: Oriental Cuisine Master

Sparta_026.desc: Welcome to the Mid-Autumn wish-making event! I heard an Oriental Cuisine Master is in town, and he is an expert at making delicate mooncakes as offerings to Artemis, the goddess of the moon. Can you bring me back some of these delicious mooncakes? I promise rich rewards for your effort. Rewards: Character Exp, Pet Exp, Character TP, Energy Zodiac. Starts: TodayEnds: Please stay tuned for upcoming announcements on our official website.
Sparta_026.name: Lunar Priest

Sparta_027.desc: I want to found a band.
Sparta_027.name: Actor

Sparta_028.desc: Where is the war, where is the bloodshed? You should protect yourself when fighting bravely.
Sparta_028.name: [Warrior]Patroklos

Sparta_029.desc: Have you ever heard Orestes? He is the Mycenaean Prince, but we have information that he has escaped to Athens with his servant Pylades.
Sparta_029.name: [Scholar]Agaue

Sparta_030.desc: Please buy some beautiful jewelry. They are all made by myself. There is a  vulture on Ares' shield.
Sparta_030.name: [Jewelry]Goldsmith

Sparta_031.desc: Three cobblers equal a rich man. Fable  says, the rich will get used to the cobbler's smell after living together.
Sparta_031.name: [Armor]Daidalos

Sparta_032.desc: If you've reached Level 50 and you wish to take on a wanted quest, come see me before 9:00pm. I can help you by issuing up to 5 wanted quests each day. Once the wanted quest you've taken on has been completed and turned in to the Wanted Quest Assesor, you will be rewarded. You can also help with wanted quests others have taken on, but you can only complete 5 wanted quests at most on any single day.
Sparta_032.name: Wanted Quest Issuer

Sparta_033.desc: During 11:00am to 11:45am Wed. and Sun. 9:00pm to 9:45pm Sat,the transporter beside me can send you to the Pindus Mountain Battlefield.
Sparta_033.name: Pindus Master

Sparta_034.desc: Although Ajax.E is brave, I will try my best to surpass him. Why not come with me?
Sparta_034.name: [Skill]Ajax

Sparta_035.desc: Ho ho ho, Merry Christmas! This year, we’re gonna make the BIGGEST reindeer in the name of the festive spirit – one horn at a time! At the top of every odd hour (1:00AM, 3:00AM, etc.) in Peloponnese, Nemea and Argolis, a horde of mischievous little reindeers will be running rampant in the city, and it will be up to YOU to capture these little devils with a pair of special gloves from me! Of course, you’ll be rewarded accordingly – capture enough of these reindeers to upgrade the Giant Reindeer by a level, and everyone gets an extra reward each time!
Sparta_035.name: Santa Claus

Sparta_036.desc: You should take enough potion to sustain your strength. I have many kinds to choose from.
Sparta_036.name: [Props]Aglaia

Sparta_037.desc: My master is not only skillful, but also intelligent. Do you want some armor? They are all fashionable.
Sparta_037.name: [Armor]Cobbler Trainee

Sparta_038.desc: To forge Metal containers you must use a very high temperature. You can master it after learning for a period. But processing and enchasing gems requires skill and patience. Not everyone can do it.
Sparta_038.name: [Jewelry]Artisan

Sparta_039.desc: All Guild members must help build up the Guild. Do this by completing any of my quests, and we will keep your contributions in mind.
Sparta_039.name: [Guild] Quest Supervisor

Sparta_040.desc: Hi, please pray for Ares every week so that you will get his blessing.
Sparta_040.name: [Daily Quest]Main City Issuer

Sparta_041.desc: Warriors, are you ready? Fight for Sparta.
Sparta_041.name: [Polis Quest]Issuer

Sparta_042.desc: I can send you to a remote place, but I suggest you reach a certain level before going there.
Sparta_042.name: Transporter

Sparta_043.desc: Hey, boy, why do you point at me? Do you want to join the council? You need more training.
Sparta_043.name: Senator

Sparta_044.desc: In Greece, you can choose to be a Warrior, Champion, Mage or Priest. Each of these classes have their own strong points.   If you are Level 100 or below, I am willing to shift your class to another and also shift your equipped items into items specific to the new class for free. If you are above Level 100, you should hand me 1 Class Shift Permit, otherwise I won't help you to shift your class.
Sparta_044.name: Class Shifter

Sparta_045.desc: Do you know how to distinguish the direction in the fog? I pray for wind to dispel the fog...
Sparta_045.name: Citizen

Sparta_046.desc: Do you need my help to turn in a completed wanted quest? Once you've completed one wanted quest, I will reward you with one medal, which can be exchanged with the Wanted Warrant Issuer beside me for a variety of cool items.
Sparta_046.name: Wanted Quest Assessor

Sparta_047.desc: I find an unbelievable phenomenon here: People throw children to the outdoors and let them learn survival skills. Now the place where people throw children is called "Mount Taygetos".
Sparta_047.name: Spartan Traveler

Sparta_048.desc: I have seen lots of relics. It's not so great! Pentacle is the symbol of Kore. The Star of David is the seal of the Jews from the desert land far away.
Sparta_048.name: Retired Wizard

Sparta_049.desc: Hey, traveler, I am Menetheus, the Spartan Guild Registrar. As long as you have reached level 30 and possess a "Guild Stone", I will approve the founding of your guild so that numerous Greek fighters will gather around you. If a guild lord is offline for 15 consecutive days, any guild member can apply to dismiss the lord. After the application is successful, a new guild lord will be elected according to members' position and Gold contribution.
Sparta_049.name: [Guild] Guild Reg

Sparta_050.desc: Now I am in charge of communication between you and gods. Ares will bless all the Spartan warriors.
Sparta_050.name: [Guild]Alter Supervisor

Sparta_051.desc: As a member of the guild, you are entitled to all the benefits of membership. Come here for weekly prayer to double your EXP and talent points.
Sparta_051.name: [Guild] Member Advisor

Sparta_052.desc: Everyone thinks I am a fisherman, but I know Athena. What do you want to exchange for?
Sparta_052.name: [Exchange]Mentor

Sparta_053.desc: Happy Halloween! Everybody will be able to get a beautiful Halloween suit from me on this day each year. I also have plenty of pumpkin candy to give away......Oh, where is it?......where's my pumpkin candy?......The little candies played a trick on me! They have changed into devils and flown to the main city to cause trouble. Put on your Halloween suit and catch them using the mysteriously powerful Halloween wand. Catch them and I'll reward you well.
Sparta_053.name: Halloween Envoy

Sparta_054.desc: To increase the efficiency of camp construction, I gather various kinds of resources from citizens on behalf of the country on a random basis. Just bring your resources to us if you need to exchange them. Satisfactory terms and conditions are guaranteed! The first phase of the Hermes Stone recycling program will conclude soon, and the second phase of the Life Essence and Crystal recycling program has officially begun. Remember, these programs don't last long, so please make a quick move if you'd like to exchange your resources!
Sparta_054.name: Retrieving Officer

Sparta_055.desc: War is imminent! In order to tally the number of soldiers fit for duty, the general has asked me to distribute one Nameplate to each Athenian warrior every day from Monday to Saturday. The Nameplates can be exchanged for Talent Points and Exp. Come improve your fighting abilities in defense of our beloved Sparta!
Sparta_055.name: Faction Crier

Sparta_056.desc: Our war with the Athenians has raged for a generation – from the Pindus Mountain to the Lelantine Farm. Euboea have always been good friends with us, but now they are being attacked by our enemies. We cannot stand by idly. From  10:45pm and 11:30pm on Saturdays, you can enter the Lelantine Farm to teach those Athenians a lesson. Notes:  Claim your rewards for the fight before 11:55pm, or else you will forfeit them.
Sparta_056.name: Battlefield Transporter

Sparta_057.desc: I am not a native. My current appearance is not my real appearance. Nevertheless, I am always pleased to help. As a matter of fact, the centaurs here have never been very peaceful. I've often wondered when the centaurs will be able to live peacefully like us humans.
Sparta_057.name: [Village Leader]Stefanos

Sparta_058.desc: I am Cupid, the god of love and beauty. If you wish to marry your sweetheart then you can get engaged to them here. Then you must go to get a Whelk Necklace for me from Pan's Maze. Remember to apply to get married once you've got the necklace. I am not free every day, you know.                                              Notes: It's the man's responsibility to submit the applications to get engaged, married or to commence the wedding ceremony.
Sparta_058.name: Cupid

Sparta_059.desc: I am Cupid's right hand man. Weddings should be exciting and fun. If you want to make a wedding go with a bang come don't forget to bring some red packets and fireworks!
Sparta_059.name: Wedding Priest

Sparta_060.desc: Come find me if you want to enter an instance! For a more challenging task, visit the Training Ground, but remember, you need to be at least level 40 to qualify.  For the ultimate adventure, join the Medusa Challenge, but you need to be at least level 90 to participate. It is a new instance which is located at sea. Great rewards, including Honor that can be exchanged for better items, await those with the courage to fight for them.
Sparta_060.name: Instance Caller

Sparta_061.desc: Zeus' lover has been kidnapped. Can you do the Thundergod a favor? I suppose Zeus can wait till you are level 50...
Sparta_061.name: Labyrinth Quest Envoy

Sparta_062.desc: Sicily has gone to hell, damned Hades! In order to purify and rebuild Sicily, we must destroy the inhuman monsters there.
Sparta_062.name: Sicily Refugee

Sparta_064.desc: During the Alpha Test, they bravely slaughtered monsters with the zeal of a veteran, while also fearlessly completing the most difficult quests. Truly the best of the best. Sparta_068.desc: Hey, come here! I have a wide range of goods. If you pay me with Bound Gold, I will give you some rare things.
Sparta_068.name: B-GOLD Shop

Sparta_069.desc: More and more people enter this ancient world everyday, but I am afraid they may get lost. When you've reached Level 50, you can apply to be a master and teach the newbies what you know, besides, they will receive special rewards from the Gods. One master can have up to 6 apprentices who are below Level 50. If they form a team, the master will gain Masters Ethics with the improvement of apprentices.
Sparta_069.name: Teaching Manager

Sparta_070.desc: Hephaestus is my master. Although I am not as skilful as him, I look more handsome. Yeah, I can help you enhance your gear, but don't tell my master.
Sparta_070.name: Gear Mentor

Sparta_071.desc: Hi, you can obtain your attribute and class titles from me! I will also reward you if you win some special titles!
Sparta_071.name: Title Expert

Sparta_072.desc: Labyrinth       Anytime                     50-140     Everyday Treasure Land   10:00pm - 11:00pm          60-140         Sun      Cursed Zone               any time          55-140       Everyday  Sicily           10:00pm - 12:00pm          25-140       Fri;     Pan's Labyrinth  12:00pm - 6:00pm          70-140      Weekends Trojan Expedition   8:00pm - 9:00pm        50-140      Thur      Romance Island   8:30pm - 9:00pm            70-140       Wed/Sat  You can also enter Sicily at any time with a Mystic Spell except Fridays.  Romance Island is accessible 4:30pm--5:00pm on Sundays
Sparta_072.name: Event Transporter

Sparta_073.desc: Please claim the rewards between 11:45am-11:55pm on Wednesdays and Sundays, and 9:45pm-11:55pm on Saturdays after the battlefield event ends.
Sparta_073.name: Battlefield Awarder

Sparta_074.desc: This is a Wishing Pool. It is said that it will grant player's wishes.
Sparta_074.name: Wishing Pool

Sparta_075.desc: As an oracle in touch with the divine power of the Gods, I can change your zodiac and grant you extraordinary luck for one day. However, I must use my divine power so the lucky time will be limited.
Sparta_075.name: Fortune Teller

Sparta_076.desc: You can hand in any war materials to me, but I won't pay much. However, you can send the war materials to War Supplier 2 in the suburbs or War Supplier 3 in Peloponnesus, they may give you higher prices.
Sparta_076.name: War Supplier 1

Sparta_077.desc: If you have enough points, you can come find me and exchange for rewards that will help enhance your equipment.
Sparta_077.name: Point Exchanger

Sparta_078.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Sparta_078.name: Fitness Trainer 6

Sparta_079.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Sparta_079.name: Fitness Trainer 7

Sparta_080.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Sparta_080.name: Fitness Trainer 8

Sparta_081.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Sparta_081.name: Fitness Trainer 9

Sparta_082.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Sparta_082.name: Fitness Trainer 10

Sparta_083.desc: I am an old man. Don't ask where I'm from or where I'll go 'cuz I wouldn't tell you even if I knew. I am here to retrieve the Lost Book, so I will be able to give you one Sheepskin Scroll 7 everyday. You need to get the other scrolls from the Boogyman that respawns every 2 hrs in the surburbs. Beware their leaders, because they usually have a Sheepskin Scroll 7 on them. Follow the instructions on the scroll to find the corresponding Lost Book Chapters. Once you have collected them, I can help you piece them together into a fullversion of the Lost Book, and with it, you can obtain great rewards at the Wishing Pool.
Sparta_083.name: Mysterious Elder

Sparta_084.desc: I am the Festival Envoy, and during the festivities, players who reach Level 30 can come to me and claim a small gift. In addition, all players can come to me and claim EXP fun time every weekend.
Sparta_084.name: Festival Envoy

Sparta_085.desc: Don't call me Master Vestment Forger. Or else, I will be ashamed because the craft to forge vestments was invented by Hephaestus, the god of fire and metal-working, but I have merely mastered superficial knowledge of the craft.
Sparta_085.name: Master Vestment Forger

Sparta_086.desc: Hey, adventurer, have you ever heard the ana "The vestment that has not been improved by a holy stone is not a good vestment"? Errr, I've forgotten which celebrity first said that. Anyway, he is right. Why not improve your vestments with holy stones now?
Sparta_086.name: Holy Stone Artisan

Sparta_087.desc: I am selling good stuffs. Traveler, why not browse my goods? Just give me some  Bound Gold, I will give you some rare items in return. Don't tell this secret to others, okay?
Sparta_087.name: Bound Gold Vendor

Sparta_088.desc: I am a mage from Temple of Artemis on Delos Island. I'm able to communicate with pets. Bring me a pet, and I can help you prepare a Soul Contract, which allows you to merge a pet with another to concentrate their power, or allows your pet to be reborn; both paths are designed to strengthrn your pet. If you can get Pixie's Tear, I can reveal the pet's hidden growth rate. If you have Seal Jade (empty), I can seal your pet for trade if it hasn't been bounded to you.
Sparta_088.name: Pet Manager

Sparta_089.desc: Have you ever heard about the Sphinx? It's an Egyptian pharaoh's pet. Just browse my goods, I am able to make your pet even stronger than the Sphinx.
Sparta_089.name: Pet Merchant

Sparta_090.desc: Pan sent me here to assist those brave warriors who wish to visit his labyrinth! Give me all 6 invitation parts, and I will give you an invitation letter and a certificate that can be redeemed for a free gift!
Sparta_090.name: Pan's Envoy

Sparta_091.desc: I am Cupid's shadow. I'm always on the opposite side of Cupid. For example, I've been really busy lately handling applications for broken engagements and divorces. Ha-ha nothing lasts for ever!
Sparta_091.name: Cupid's Shadow

Sparta_092.desc: Happy Spring Festival! This year, Valentine's Day will be during Spring Festival. Love and renewal are in the air, but some annoying Snow Demons have begun attacking Sparta! The nerve of these beast! They have already reached the suburbs of Sparta. We must prevent them from invading the city! Brave adventurers, go destroy the  Snow Demons. They will drop a lot of cool stuff when killed that you can then exchange with me for cool rewards.
Sparta_092.name: Spring Festival Envoy

Sparta_093.desc: I give out the round quest.
Sparta_093.name: [Round Quest]Main City Issuer

Sparta_094.desc: Hello. You will benefit a lot from communicating with friends. Please left click on an NPC and choose a function from the user menu after clicking a player. You can click quest target to Auto-trace after accepting a quest. Is it easy?
Sparta_094.name: [Newbie Guide]

Sparta_095.desc: Haha, I have everything that you expect to find. Come to buy it!
Sparta_095.name: [Props Merchant]Zinoviou

Sparta_096.desc: Hi, warrior! I have all kinds of weapons for you to choose from.
Sparta_096.name: [Warrior Supplier]Simonos

Sparta_097.desc: Forging gear is manual labor and inlaying is mental labor. If you are not careful, it will...Hephaestus is our Ironsmiths's patron saint. Lots of legendary weapons were made by him.
Sparta_097.name: Viktoros

Sparta_098.desc: Hello. There is no special event in the village today. When your level increases, you can accept a quest from the person who has a "question mark above their head".
Sparta_098.name: Ion

Sparta_099.desc: There are lots of monsters outside the newbie camp, trying to defeat them is the best training.
Sparta_099.name: [Skill Merchant]Thisbe

Sparta_100.desc: Hi, warehouses can be used to deposit items, do you want to do so? There is an Argo at the foot of Pelion. It is made by many craftsmen under the guidance of Athena.
Sparta_100.name: [Warehouse]Savva

Sparta_101.desc: How are you, my dear friend?
Sparta_101.name: Foka

Sparta_102.desc: Prepare enough materials before fighting against monsters, so you can win. Are you ready? I have a variety of armor, have a look!
Sparta_102.name: [Armor Merchant]Judaeus

Sparta_103.desc: I am good at painting buildings.
Sparta_103.name: Artem

Sparta_104.desc: It is very important for a warrior to sustain physical strength. Do you want to buy some potions?
Sparta_104.name: Fanouriou

Sparta_105.desc: We don't fight alone. Have you ever heard of the Argo Volunteer Club?  I am a member...
Sparta_105.name: Odysseus

Sparta_106.desc: I am a stranger, it's not my true face, but I will give my helping hand if I am needed.
Sparta_106.name: Acacia

Sparta_107.desc: A wise scholar needs cool gear. Don't forget to update!
Sparta_107.name: [Scholar Supplier]Ianeira

Sparta_108.desc: I come from Corinth. Do you know the sea is green, so my name is Glauce.
Sparta_108.name: [Jewelry Merchant]Glauce

Sparta_109.desc: I am an apothecary.                                                To exchange gems or crystals for exp potions, or transfer potions, come see me.
Sparta_109.name: Apothecary

Sparta_110.desc: I am sent by Hera to distribute pet eggs to people of this world. Once you have an egg, click on it to hatch your baby pet.
Sparta_110.name: Pet Master

Sparta_111.desc: In order to enjoy a peaceful Spring Festival, we must defeat the Lunar Beast. This is not too difficult, but it is not without dangers. To get started we must first lure it out. People say the best way to lure this monster out from the shadows is with Spring Festival Firecrackers. This is where you come in. I need some special goods for Spring Festival, and if you bring them to me I will reward you with Spring Festival Firecrackers. If you want to learn more about how to find the Lunar Beast, talk with the Lunar Beast Slayer beside me.
Sparta_111.name: Spring Merrymaker

Sparta_112.desc: Great, now's my time to shine. First, get some Spring Festival Firecrackers from the Spring Merrymaker beside me. I will lure the Lunar Beast out when I've lit enough Spring Festival Firecrackers, then we can defeat it together. I'll even reward you for bringing it down. Do you want a fantastic Flying Carpet or a cute snowman?
Sparta_112.name: Lunar Beast Slayer

Sparta_113.desc: The Almighty Zeus rules over the Olympian Gods with wisdom and gives us strength. I am unable to give him anything in return, except my gratitude and loyal service. Would you like to do the same? Zeus will know of your devotion and give you blessings in return. Also, the more gifts you deliver, the greater the rewards - even double on the weekends! Just a hint, the  Cursed Zone  and  Treasure Land  have many of Zeus' favorite gifts.
Sparta_113.name: [Event]Zeus' Loyal Believer

Sparta_114.desc: Dear friend, you must always keep mind that without Zeus' blessings we cannot live a good life at all. During every  0:00PM Saturday and 11:55PM Sunday, Zeus always commands me to give out innumerous precious treasures, including a great deal of experience and talent points. If you want to get them, you must first offer Zeus Praying Stone.
Sparta_114.name: [Event]Praying Saint

Sparta_115.desc: Provide a Mid-autumn Festival Gift Pack Dollar to me, and you will get a great gift pack containing Level 2 Crystal*50,  Greater Pixie Bag*1,  Level 3 Ruby*3, Level 3 Sapphire *3, Level 3 Emerald *3, Energy Holy Water*10, 10 of each a variety of Enduring Potion, Golden Iris*20, Super Healing Potion*99,  Super Mana Potion*99, Mysterious String Bag *10, Super Firework*5, Anima Potion*10 and pieces of a Magic Jade of the rare Blue Crystal Dragon.
Sparta_115.name: Mid-autumn Gift Pack Giver

Sparta_116.desc: I am the best mount feeder in all of Greece. Just get your mount here in one piece, and I'll take care of the rest.
Sparta_116.name: Mount Feeder

Sparta_117.desc: Come on! Get those naughty  Bunnies for me! The Bunnies will spawn  Easter Eggs. Turn in the eggs to me for prizes. The prizes are available  1 hour  after the Bunny  turns up. An extra  Weak Bunny will go to the player who turns in the largest number of Easter Eggs. The prizes must be claimed before the next round of  Bunnies spawn, or they will be forfeited. Only  Lvl 20+ players are allowed participate in the Bunny busting event.
Sparta_117.name: Easter Bunny Envoy

Sparta_118.desc: You will receive a Quest Sack from me to complete the Scroll Quest. After the quest is complete you will be rewarded with an Exp Pill and a chance at a Morning Dew. Each round includes 10 quests, the more quests you complete the more rewards you will receive. After completing the 10th quest, you will be rewarded with an extra Talent Stone 3.
Sparta_118.name: Random Quest Manager

Sparta_119.desc: Hey, I am the envoy for IGG's special anniversary celebrations. Brave warrior, can you help me unlock the Treasure Chest? IGG has prepared big anniversary gifts!However, I dropped the key to the Treasure Chest by accident, and the key ended up several hundred pieces. I need you to retract some of  these pieces from Key Collector at Peloponnesus (73, -21)  or Marathon (81,63) . Be wary of the hostile Anniversary Chest Bandits who will assault whoever is holding a full set of pieces near the Anniversary Chest. Anniversary Chests need to be defended carefully, as those bandits are not pushovers.
Sparta_119.name: IGG Anniversary Envoy

Sparta_120.desc: There are 4 types of Professions in GodsWar Online,Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Mythcrafting and Scholarship. If you are unhappy with your current profession, you may unlearn it and start a new one, but  this will completely remove all traces of the former profession,including any skills or recipes associated with it. Please make sure this is acceptable before you unlearn a profession.
Sparta_120.name: Profession Mentor

Sparta_121.desc: Hey, come take a look at my goods! Best in all of Greece!
Sparta_121.name: Alchemy Recipe Vendor

Sparta_122.desc: Look here! Good Ingredients for sale at reasonable price.
Sparta_122.name: Ingredients Vendors

Sparta_123.desc: A convenient and thrilling chest where you claim the prizes (including B-GOLD) handed out by GM.
Sparta_123.name: Prize Chest

Sparta_124.desc: You can claim rewards from me after the event has closed.
Sparta_124.name: Event Awarder

Sparta_125.desc: Paris, the seductive prince of Troy, lured Helen away to the city of Troy.  Agamemnon, the great Greek leader has decided to launch an attack on Troy to get her back and teach the Trojans a lesson for their impudence.  All warriors in the land should join the fight for the glory of Greece!
Sparta_125.name: Trojan War Coordinator

Sparta_126.desc: A certain amount of wish-making credits is to be earned if you buy the selected items from the Item Mall before Sept 29th.      Before October 13th, you can use the earned wish-making credits to wish for the cool and rare items not available in the Item Mall. Your wish might come true with certain odds. Hesitate no further, and head over to win.
Sparta_126.name: Carnival Envoy

Sparta_127.desc: I am responsible for the security of traders and merchants here.                The Treasure Bandits have been stealing from more and more people over the past several weeks, and we cannot let it continue. They must be brought to justice. This is why we are empowering anyone brave enough to face them with the task of capturing them.
Sparta_127.name: Treasury Official

Sparta_128.desc: We’re introducing a fun new event in celebration of Easter! Click the Event Details button to find out more.
Sparta_128.name: Easter Envoy

Sparta_129.desc: I am the Rich Man Envoy. How about trying your luck here? Just hand over some Level 1 crystals to me for your chance to get rich quick!
Sparta_129.name: Rich Man Envoy

Sparta_130.desc: I am the Sacred Sealer:                                                                                                                  I have some scrolls that have legendary creatures sealed inside. With these scrolls, you can summon these beasts. Once they have been defeated, you can loot their treasure. Don't think for a moment these scrolls are free, do you know what I had to do to get them...? Actually it's better if I don't tell you. At any rate, you've got to cough up some Gold if you want one of these scrolls.
Sparta_130.name: Sacred Sealer

Sparta_131.desc: Everyone will be able to exchange up to 3 [Holy Stone Package Vouchers] with me for 3 bound [Holy Stone Packages]. One for one. [Holy Stone Package Vouchers] can be purchased from the [Item Mall] for only 1800 Gold. Each [Holy Stone Package Voucher] can be exchanged for one [Holy Stone Package] containing items worth up to 6,100 Gold.  If you have bought too many [Holy Stone Package Vouchers], you must return the unused ones for a refund . o learn how to use Holy Stones, check out our in-game tutorial here.[LINK to tutorial]
Sparta_131.name: Holy Stone Redeemer

Sparta_132.desc: Claim one Online Award per server day. Rewards are configured by the server and may change.
Sparta_132.name: Online Award Admin

Sparta_133.desc: B-Gold Trader  Greetings! I've made a fortune trading B-Gold, and if you would like to take advantage of my services, I'll give you 360 B-Gold in exchange for 180 Gold. Keep in mind I don't carry a lot of B-Gold with me, after all one can't be too careful these days, so I can only trade with each player once each day.Notes.    1.B-Gold binds when acquired. B-Gold can be used to purchase items from the [B-Gold vendor] and the [B-Gold shop] located in the area of (145,-137) in each of the main cities.2. Players can only exchange for B-Gold once each day.3. Players can only exchange for B-Gold between the hours of 12:00AM and 11:55PM each day.
Sparta_133.name: B-Gold Trader

Sparta_134.desc: With my help, you'll be able to open a lot more Storagee Boxes using the same amount of Storage Box Keys.
Sparta_134.name: Warehouse Manager

Sparta_135.desc: Hey, come take a look at my goods! Best in all of Greece!
Sparta_135.name: Forging Recipe Vendor

Sparta_136.desc: Hey, come take a look at my goods! Best in all of Greece!
Sparta_136.name: Mythcrafting Recipe Vendor

Sparta_137.desc: Hey, come take a look at my goods! Best in all of Greece!
Sparta_137.name: Scholarship Recipe Vendor

Sparta_138.desc: Do you want to change your gender? Don't just stand there staring, if you're not happy the way you are now, then tell me. Are you sure you want to change your gender?
Sparta_138.name: Plastic Surgeon

Sparta_139.desc: I know how troublesome it is to only be able to use items one at a time - as such, I've devised a way to enable batch usage of [Morning Dew I], [EXP Stone 3], and [Talent Stone 3]! Well, you can thank me later!
Sparta_139.name: Personal Helper

Sparta_140.desc: Hail, adventurer! I'm from faraway, and I deal in all kinds of exotic and fine wares. Take a look!
Sparta_140.name: Mystery Merchant

Sparta_141.desc: Do you want to change your faction? Don’t just stand there in silence; if you’re not satisfied with your current faction, let me know. Are you certain you want to switch factions?
Sparta_141.name: Faction Changer

Sparta_142.desc: Ah, a bold adventurer! I see you’ve reached the Level 89. Would you like me to seal your level? Once sealed, you’ll remain at 89 but can still gain experience. This is useful for honing your skills and earning rewards without leveling up further. Think carefully—once sealed, you’ll be locked at this level until you choose to unseal. If you’re ready, let me know, and I’ll take care of the rest.
Sparta_142.name: Level Sealer

Sparta_143.desc: I may not be as skilled as Hephaestus, but I know how to make your gear shine. Whether it’s your mount or your wardrobe, I can enhance them to perfection. Just don't expect my master to approve of my... extra flair."
Sparta_143.name: Origin Enhancer

Sparta_Newbie_001.desc: Do you know how to tame an animal into a pet? Listen to me, it's so easy, all you need is the right tool.
Sparta_Newbie_001.name: Farmer Layland

Sparta_Newbie_002.desc: Damn, my farmland has been almost completely destroyed.
Sparta_Newbie_002.name: Farmer Kozma

Sparta_Newbie_003.desc: Would you please help me return to the fishing village? It is being occupied by a lot of evil monsters.
Sparta_Newbie_003.name: Fisher Calisto

Sparta_Newbie_004.desc: When you hit a new level, you will be able to learn new spells from some items. You can loot these items from monsters or they can be purchased from the Mall. Once you've gained a new spell, remember to press the S key to unfold your spell panel and drag the spell into the action bar for quick use.
Sparta_Newbie_004.name: [Skill]Theophilus

Sparta_Newbie_005.desc: I am busy inspecting everyone and everything. You wouldn't believe how corrupt and evil everyone is. But I will continue to work hard to bring peace and justice to this beautiful land.
Sparta_Newbie_005.name: Inspector Nolan

Sparta_Newbie_006.desc: There are several tough criminals on the wanted list. Do you dare to attempt to capture any of them?
Sparta_Newbie_006.name: Wanted Criminals

Sparta_Newbie_007.desc: We don't fight alone. Have you ever heard of the Argo Volunteer Club?  I am a member...
Sparta_Newbie_007.name: Odysseus

Sparta_Newbie_008.desc: I am a stranger, it's not my true face, but I will give my helping hand if I am needed.
Sparta_Newbie_008.name: Chiron

Sparta_Newbie_009.desc: Haha, I have everything that you expect to find. Come to buy it!
Sparta_Newbie_009.name: [Props]Zinoviou

Sparta_Newbie_010.desc: Hi, warrior! I have all kinds of weapons for you to choose from.
Sparta_Newbie_010.name: [Warrior]Simonos

Sparta_Newbie_011.desc: A wise scholar needs cool gear. Don't forget to update!
Sparta_Newbie_011.name: [Scholar]Ianeira

Sparta_Newbie_012.desc: Hi, warehouses can be used to deposit items, do you want to do so? There is an Argo at the foot of Pelion. It is made by many craftsmen under the guidance of Athena.
Sparta_Newbie_012.name: [Warehouse]Savva

Sparta_Newbie_013.desc: There are lots of monsters outside the newbie camp, trying to defeat them is the best training.
Sparta_Newbie_013.name: [Skill]Filippou

Sparta_Newbie_014.desc: Prepare enough materials before fighting against monsters, so you can win. Are you ready? I have a variety of armor, have a look!
Sparta_Newbie_014.name: [Armor]Aglaias

Sparta_Newbie_015.desc: I come from Corinth. Do you know the sea is green, so my name is Glauce.
Sparta_Newbie_015.name: [Jewelry]Glauce

Sparta_Newbie_016.desc: Welcome! There is a Dodona Oak Wood given by Athena on the Argo wall. It can be used for announcing oracles.
Sparta_Newbie_016.name: [Props]Cora

Sparta_Newbie_017.desc: I plan to participate in the Sports Competition in Olympia. But Olympia belongs to Elis Polis now. The king of Elis wants to sign a peace contract with Sparta during the competition. The torch relay is mysterious and superb...I am good at wrestling and throwing discus.
Sparta_Newbie_017.name: Olympics Competitor

Sparta_Newbie_018.desc: If you are level 20-75, then I can send you to some special Newbie practicing maps between  8:00pmto9:00pm every day.
Sparta_Newbie_018.name: Newbie Events Transporter

Sparta_Newbie_019.desc: I am sent by Hera to distribute pet eggs to people of this world. Once you have an egg, click on it to hatch your baby pet.
Sparta_Newbie_019.name: Pet Master

Sparta_Newbie_020.desc: When you reach level 10, come to me to claim some gear. You will be rewarded every 5 levels from Level 10 to Level 40.
Sparta_Newbie_020.name: Gear Giver

Sparta_Newbie_021.desc: Ha-ha, happy holidays! I only appear on special holidays. Don't miss out the gifts I am giving away!
Sparta_Newbie_021.name: Gift Envoy

Sparta_Newbie_022.desc: Warrior, when you reach Level 3, 15 and 31, come talk with me and I will teach a bit more as well as give you rewards for working so hard.
Sparta_Newbie_022.name: Instructor

Sparta_Newbie_023.desc: I won't accept the materials until you give it to me while in a team with 5 people. Different materials will bring you different rewards.  Certainly, you can also hand in materials to CWar Supplier 1 in the main city or War Supplier 3 in Peloponnesus.
Sparta_Newbie_023.name: War Supplier 2

Sparta_Newbie_024.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to attend the round-the-city race 12:00am-11:55pm, every Monday through Saturday. You are allowed to join the race up to  6 times  a day! You will be rewarded 180 B-GOLD each the first two races in a day, and 90 B-GOLD for every race thereafter that day.
Sparta_Newbie_024.name: Fitness Trainer 1

Sparta_Newbie_025.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Sparta_Newbie_025.name: Fitness Trainer 2

Sparta_Newbie_026.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Sparta_Newbie_026.name: Fitness Trainer 3

Sparta_Newbie_027.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Sparta_Newbie_027.name: Fitness Trainer 4

Sparta_Newbie_028.desc: Hello, I am Hygeia's envoy. You are welcome to take part in the round-the-city race!
Sparta_Newbie_028.name: Fitness Trainer 5

Sparta_Newbie_029.desc: Exchange Sheepskin Scroll 1 for Lost Book Chapter 1.
Sparta_Newbie_029.name: Ancient Relics 1

Sparta_Newbie_030.desc: Exchange Sheepskin Scroll 6 for Lost Book Chapter 6.
Sparta_Newbie_030.name: Ancient Relics 6

Sparta_Newbie_031.desc: The Almighty Zeus rules over the Olympian Gods with wisdom and gives us strength. I am unable to give him anything in return, except my gratitude and loyal service. Would you like to do the same? Zeus will know of your devotion and give you blessings in return. Also, the more gifts you deliver, the greater the rewards - even double on the weekends! Just a hint, the  Cursed Zone  and  Treasure Land  have many of Zeus' favorite gifts.
Sparta_Newbie_031.name: [Event]Zeus' Loyal Believer

Sparta_Newbie_032.desc: Dear friend, you must always keep mind that without Zeus' blessings we cannot live a good life at all. During every 9 0:00PM Saturday and 11:55PM Sunday, Zeus always commands me to give out innumerous precious treasures, including a great deal of experience and talent points. If you want to get them, you must first offer Zeus Praying Stone.
Sparta_Newbie_032.name: [Event]Praying Saint

Thebes_All_001.desc: Greetings, I am Kreon, King of Thebes.
Thebes_All_001.name: kreon

Thebes_All_002.desc: Somebody said I was destined to kill my father at some point, but I could never do such a thing.
Thebes_All_002.name: Oedipus

Thebes_All_003.desc: My father is Theseus, and my mother is Hippolyte, the Amazonian queen possessing a magical girdle given by her father Ares, the God of war. Everyone knows the Amazon warriors, they are as famous for their beauty, as they are for their strength and courage.
Thebes_All_003.name: Hippolytus

Thebes_All_004.desc: Cronus is near the border with Attica somewhere. The people are always willing to protect righteous fighters.
Thebes_All_004.name: Tiresias

Thebes_All_005.desc: My beloved sister Antigone can be pretty sentimental at times.
Thebes_All_005.name: Ismene

Thebes_All_006.desc: I've finally arrived home. My father is Oedipus, who is known throughout the land for solving the riddle of the Sphinx.
Thebes_All_006.name: Polynices

Thebes_All_008.desc: What animals walk on 4 legs in the morning, 3 legs in the afternoon and 2 legs in the evening? That's too difficult for me to answer.
Thebes_All_008.name: Jocasta

Thebes_All_009.desc: Minos, the hateful Lord of Crete, is my brother, but he exiled me to Boeotia. I have come to accept my exile and plan to found a new nation on this pure, fertile land.
Thebes_All_009.name: Rhadamanthus

Thebes_All_010.desc: Want a massage? I rub you long time.
Thebes_All_010.name: Physician

Thebes_All_011.desc: Thebes has seven city gates. Do you know how to breach them?
Thebes_All_011.name: [Props]Andrea

Thebes_All_012.desc: Ariadne is my younger sister. We are both very fond of Theseus.
Thebes_All_012.name: [Warehouse]Phaedra

Thebes_All_013.desc: Machaon is my brother. Hopefully I can become a great surgeon like him.
Thebes_All_013.name: Podaleirios

Thebes_All_014.desc: I should wear a hood and a cloak to look like a travelling surgeon.
Thebes_All_014.name: Telesphoros

Thebes_All_015.desc: I am Haemon, son of Kreon.
Thebes_All_015.name: Haemon

Thebes_All_016.desc: Hotsprings are effective in pacifying souls and healing scars. So I believe building a statue beside the hotspring will be a very significant thing.
Thebes_All_016.name: Epione

Thebes_All_017.desc: All talented surgeons hold staves in their hands, looking very cool.
Thebes_All_017.name: Aceso

Thebes_All_019.desc: Mountains almost cover the whole eastern part of Greece, where there exists various strange creatures. By the way, have you ever seen a camel? There are no camels here, but poisonous snakes and huge dragons.
Thebes_All_019.name: Viotia Ranger

Thebes_All_020.desc: Have you ever heard of Andromeda, the Ethiopian princess? People created a statue for her along the coast.
Thebes_All_020.name: [Props]Andrea

Thebes_All_021.desc: The churchwomen of Dionysus always like to host carnivals on Cithaero.
Thebes_All_021.name: Resting Male Priest

Thebes_All_022.desc: I heard the Argo Volunteer Club had taken Polynices and Tydeus in.
Thebes_All_022.name: [Warrior]Servant

Thebes_All_023.desc: Polynices is Oedipus' son. Polynices has gone to Corinth but Oedipus is lost.
Thebes_All_023.name: [Scholar]Believer

Thebes_All_024.desc: Thebes has seven city gates. Do you know how to breach them?
Thebes_All_024.name: [Skill]Agent

Thebes_All_025.desc: Ariadne is my younger sister. We are both fond of Theseus.
Thebes_All_025.name: [Jewelry]Phaedra

Thebes_All_026.desc: Greetings, we are express deliverers. It is our pleasure to help you deliver anything you like as fast as we can run!
Thebes_All_026.name: [Warehouse]Origin Express

Thebes_All_027.desc: Brave one - will you really teleport to Mycenae? It's dangerous! Mycenae opens from 12:00 - 23:55                                Level Requirement: 130+ (includes 130)                           Fees: 20,000 Silver                                                 A party is recommended.
Thebes_All_027.name: Mycenae Transporter

Thebes_All_028.desc: Hail, brave adventurer! Give me enough gems, and I'll be happy to hand you some Super Skillbooks!
Thebes_All_028.name: Gem Merchant

Thermopylae_001.desc: If you want to go to Athens,please click me.
Thermopylae_001.name: Zeus' Envoy 1

Thermopylae_002.desc: If you want to go to Sparta,please click me.
Thermopylae_002.name: Zeus' Envoy 2

Thermopylae_004.desc: You can claim rewards from me after you come back from the instance.
Thermopylae_004.name: Spartan Awarder

Thermopylae_005.desc: You can claim rewards from me after you come back from the instance.
Thermopylae_005.name: Athenian Awarder

Thermopylae_All_001.desc: I give out the round quest.
Thermopylae_All_001.name: [Round Quest]Athenian Issuer

Thermopylae_All_002.desc: Daily quests are a great way to pick up big rewards. Don't forget to do them every day.
Thermopylae_All_002.name: [Daily Quest]Athenian Issuer

Thermopylae_All_003.desc: We will definitely drive the Persian invaders away from Thermopylae. Victory will belong to us!
Thermopylae_All_003.name: Aristotle

Thermopylae_All_004.desc: We will definitely drive the Persian invaders away from Thermopylae because we have so many brave fighters!
Thermopylae_All_004.name: Pausanians

Thermopylae_All_005.desc: I love Athens. I love Sparta too. You are right, I am neutral.
Thermopylae_All_005.name: Kimon

Thermopylae_All_006.desc: There are so many Persian archers that when they fire a full volley, even the bright sun is hidden from view. No matter, if that's their plan, we will fight in the shade!
Thermopylae_All_006.name: Dieneces

Thermopylae_All_007.desc: Wow, what a nice life! Everything is so beautiful!
Thermopylae_All_007.name: Simonides

Thermopylae_All_008.desc: Brave soldiers, let's fight against the Persian invaders and fight for Greece!
Thermopylae_All_008.name: Leonidas

Thermopylae_All_009.desc: My wife is a Persian, so I don't want to see war between the Greeks and Persians. However, the outcome is not up to me.
Thermopylae_All_009.name: Telephus

Thermopylae_All_010.desc: My father Telephus is the leader of Mysia. Actually, we are Greek but I have the blood of a Persian running through me... How complex the world is! Why do we fight against each other?
